title: FINAL FANTASY XI FOR WINDOWS PRESS RELEASE
body:
FINAL FANTASY XI FOR WINDOWS BEGINS SHIPPING TO NORTH AMERICAN RETAILERS OCTOBER 28, 2003

Marketing Blitz For First Online FINAL FANTASY Title Includes Promotional Campaigns with Alienware, America Online and NVIDIA

LOS ANGELES, Calif. (October 6, 2003) - Square Enix U.S.A., Inc. ("Square Enix U.S.A."), the publisher of Square Enix products in North America, announced today that FINAL FANTASY XI for Windows, the first online title in the world-renowned series, will begin shipping to North American retailers on October 28.  FINAL FANTASY XI for Windows will include the "Rise of the Zilart" expansion pack and other applications on five CD-ROM discs and carries a suggested retail price of $49.99 (USD).  

FINAL FANTASY XI subscribers will receive their first 30 days of access without charge.  Aside from Internet service provider access charges, the free trial period will begin on the date players create their first "Content ID" or character.   Any additional "Content IDs" purchased are also available without charge until the end of the free trial period. After 30 days, players can continue to play FINAL FANTASY XI by paying a monthly fee of $12.95 (USD) for one FINAL FANTASY XI character, and can create up to 15 additional characters for an additional charge of $1.00 (USD) per character, per month.  Tetra Master, the online version of the wildly popular and addictive mini-game from FINAL FANTASY IX, will also be included in the package and will be available for $1.00 (USD) per month.  Payment for monthly access charges must be made by credit card only (restrictions apply).

Marketing and Promotional Partners
In addition to a targeted marketing campaign that includes national print and online media in the top gaming and computer gaming magazines and websites, Square Enix has united with several promotional partners in its marketing efforts for FINAL FANTASY XI.  Included is a giveaway by Alienware for its "Area 51" desktop PC that comes bundled with FINAL FANTASY XI and co-branded print ads with NVIDIA.  In addition, the premiere online games destination, AOL Games, will debut a comprehensive programming package around the launch of the new game beginning October
21 available at AOL Keyword: Video Games. 


FINAL FANTASY XI

In FINAL FANTASY XI, players will undertake multiple adventures through vast environments in the world of "Vana'diel," which has more than 100 areas to explore, including mountains, forests, ice plains, deserts, oceans, rivers, castles, and dungeons. The game allows players to create their alter ego that will exist in the world of Vana'diel, choosing from a variety of races, facial features, hairstyles and colors.  They will be able to play at their own pace and form parties by utilizing the various communication tools that have been incorporated into FINAL FANTASY XI, including easy-to-use chat and messaging systems.   The inclusion of "Rise of the Zilart" will expand the storyline and open up a variety of higher-level skills and abilities.

The first cross-platform, cross-continent massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG), FINAL FANTASY XI allows gamers to connect to the same exact world regardless of whether they are playing on a personal computer (PC) or PlayStation 2 computer entertainment system and whether they are playing in North America or Japan.


PlayOnline

FINAL FANTASY XI is a multiplayer online game in which players play via the Internet, and is playable via broadband or dial-up connection on both the PC and PlayStation 2.  FINAL FANTASY XI is accessible only through the PlayOnline network service, a network service created by Square Enix.  The PlayOnline service will launch on October 28, 2003. PlayOnline provides a wide range of online services and entertainment including games, entertainment, and communication.  Thus, PlayOnline not only serves as a portal to the world of FINAL FANTASY XI, but  also a gateway to several other applications including communication tools such as email, messaging, a "Friend List," games, support, downloadable files, and audiovisual customization.  Players will create personalized PlayOnline identities or "handles" that allow other players to communicate with each other, no matter where they are on the PlayOnline network.  These basic services on the PlayOnline network will be free of charge.  For more information on PlayOnline, FINAL FANTASY XI, and Tetra Master, please visit the official  Web site at http://www.playonline.com/ff11us/index.shtml.

Square Enix U.S.A. has partnered with Sony Online Entertainment Inc.
(SOE), the online gaming division of Sony Pictures Digital, to provide in-game support and customer service by phone for both versions of FINAL FANTASY XI as well as PlayOnline.


FINAL FANTASY XI for Windows System Requirements

The minimum system requirements for FINAL FANTASY XI for Windows are as follows:  Windows 98/98 SE/Me/2000/XP, IntelR PentiumR III 800Mhz or higher, 128 MB RAM, 6 GB of hard drive space, DirectX 8.1 compatible sound card, CD-ROM drive, keyboard, 56K or faster connection, and either the ATI Radeon 9000 series or NVIDIA GeForce series video card with 32MB of RAM.


FINAL FANTASY XI for the PlayStation 2

Published by Sony Computer Entertainment America, FINAL FANTASY XI for the PlayStation 2 computer entertainment system will be pre-installed on the internal Hard Disk Drive (40GB)(for PlayStation 2).  Available in March 2004 for a suggested retail price of $99 (USD), the internal Hard Disk Drive attaches to the Network Adaptor (Ethernet/modem) (for PlayStation 2), which connects to both broadband or dial-up networks, and rests in the expansion bay of the PlayStation 2 console.    

The Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB) has rated FINAL FANTASY XI "T" for Teen.  For more information about the ESRB, visit http://www.esrb.org.

About Square Enix Co. Ltd. and Square Enix U.S.A., Inc. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Square Enix Co., Ltd. (Square Enix) develops, publishes and distributes entertainment contents including
interactive entertainment software and publications in Japan, North America, Europe and Asia.  Square Enix brings two of Japan's best-selling franchises - FINAL FANTASY,  which has sold over 45 million units worldwide and DRAGON QUEST ( DRAGON WARRIOR in North America ) which has sold over 30 million units worldwide - under one roof.  Square Enix is one of the most influential providers of digital entertainment content in the world and continues to push the boundaries of creativity and innovation. 

Square Enix U.S.A. Inc., located in Los Angeles, Calif., handles operations in North America including localization, marketing and publishing of Square Enix titles.  More information on Square Enix U.S.A. can be found on the Internet at http://www.square-enix-usa.com.

title: Trick or Treat!!
body:
Lately, it seems as if the inhabitants of San d'Oria, Bastok and Windurst have been planning something a little different during this year's harvest festival for the children and adventurers of these lands.

It'll be a time to scare the pants off people--and to snag more treats than the next person. That's what Vana'diel Halloween is all about!

Some children may masquerade as skeletons, while others may appear as ghosts from Elvaan past. There are many ways to get treats from fellow adventurers, but it's up to you to figure out the best way!

Halloween is nearing, so all you adventurers get out there and start cooking up your most delectable treats!

  [Event]
  The event will take place for a total of 4 days, from
  10/30 8:00(PST) to 11/2 20:00(PST)

  [Participating in the Event]
  -This festival will take place across the three
   countries of San d'Oria, Windurst, and Bastok.
   Walk around town and look for townsfolk who
   are dressed up for the event.

  -If you happen to run into one of these townsfolk,
   don't forget to give him or her a treat! But don't
   give out the same treat over and over again to
   the same person--how would you feel if you
   received a sack with only licorice in it? Rather,
   enjoy the different costumes and give your treats
   out to as many people as possible!

title: Welcome to PlayOnline!
body:
PlayOnline is a complete entertainment network service which includes games as well as many other kinds of communication features, information, and services.

PlayOnline is also the gateway to the incredible and ever-expanding online world of FINAL FANTASY XI! Experience the dynamic, breathtaking world of Vana'diel in the first online game in the renowned FINAL FANTASY series. Not only that, but you can also use the Friend List to communicate with your friends no matter where you are within the PlayOnline network!

-----------------------------
FINAL FANTASY XI
-----------------------------

In addition to being the gateway to the amazing world of FINAL FANTASY XI, PlayOnline provides a number of useful pages including an online manual, the Vana'diel Tribune, and other FINAL FANTASY XI content.

Note: You must purchase a Content ID to gain access to FINAL FANTASY XI.  For details, please select "Content ID" from the FINAL FANTASY XI top page.

-----------------------------
Tetra Master
-----------------------------
The popular Tetra Master card game from FINAL FANTASY IX is back, now online! In addition to Tetra Master, PlayOnline provides a number of useful pages to improve your Tetra Master experience, including an online manual, the Developers' Corner, and other Tetra Master content.

Note: You must purchase a Content ID to gain access to Tetra Master. For details, please select "Content ID" from the Tetra Master top page.

-----------------------------
Information
-----------------------------
You can access the latest news and other information from the main menu under "Information." News will appear in the following categories:

- Important Notices
- General
- Server Maintenance
- Events
- Updates

-----------------------------
Navigator
-----------------------------
Create an online profile, keep in contact with friends and make new ones with the Navigator's easy-to-use mail, chat, and Friend List features!

-----------------------------
Extras
-----------------------------
Be sure to check out the Vana'diel Tribune, greeting cards, wallpaper downloads, and more!

-----------------------------
Options
-----------------------------
Here you can customize your PlayOnline experience with a variety of sound, wallpaper, and configuration options!

-----------------------------
Quick Manuals
-----------------------------
From how to use the main menu to detailed descriptions of mail, chat, and the Friend List, the Quick Manuals are a convenient source of all information on how to use PlayOnline functions. Please be sure to visit whenever you have trouble with PlayOnline.

-----------------------------
Service & Support
-----------------------------
Here you can check agreements under Rules & Policies, make membership and service changes, and view support information for PlayOnline members. Service & Support also contains the following features for your questions or comments:

- Q&A Database: A database searchable by category and  keyword containing answers to common questions.
- E-mail Support: Mail forms for asking questions, sending in comments, or reporting problems.
- Phone Support: The latest phone support information can always be found here.

Many more features will be coming in the near future. So come on in and enjoy PlayOnline to your heart's content!

title: Regarding World Passes
body:
This guide is about the "World Passes" that exist within the realm of Vana'diel.  Please read the following carefully as it explains what the World Pass is about.

#What is a World Pass?

Using a World Pass allows a user to choose what world his/her character will exist in at creation.
 
*However, this does not grant the ability to move an existing character to another world.

#How to acquire a World Pass

You can acquire a World Pass from certain NPCs within the game. Which NPCs and how much the World Pass costs is up to you, the player, to find out.

#Things to watch for when using a World Pass:

You may create up to five characters using one World Pass.

You have one week to use the World Pass after recieving it. After one week has passed the World Pass expires and becomes invalid.

You cannot get multiple World Passes in succession. After acquring one World Pass, you must wait one week (in real time) until you can obtain another one.

If the character that acquired the World Pass is deleted, that World Pass will become invalid.

title: The PlayOnline Viewer's GM Call Feature
body:
The PlayOnline Viewer's GM Call service has not started.  We will notify you once this service begins.

You can still call a GM from within FINAL FANTASY XI, but please check the Q&A database first to see whether your question is already answered there.  The Q&A database is available from both the PlayOnline Viewer and the official FINAL FANTASY XI web site. If you still cannot find an answer to your question, please feel free to request a GM's assistance during gameplay.

We ask that you do not use GM Call for any of the following:

- Ideas and suggestions
- License agreement issues
- Issues you encounter before logging into PlayOnline
- Previously reported issues (including scheduled maintenance)

Instead, please use the designated mail forms or contact the PlayOnline Information Center about such matters.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation!

title: On Additional Characters and their Worlds
body:
Newly created characters will exist in the same world as any created previously, unless a player obtains and uses a World Pass.

If a player already possesses several different characters that exist on different worlds, those characters will be displayed in the upper left of the character selection screen. Users may specify in which world the new character will exist, so long as the world specified is one occupied by a pre-existing character.

title: Talk to Anyone with the Auto-translate Function!
body:
FINAL FANTASY XI has an auto-translate function. Press the TAB key to display a list of common phrases. This phrase dictionary can be used to
auto-complete words when entering text. These phrases will appear in either English or Japanese, depending on the version of the game that your fellow players are using.

You cannot modify or add to the list of common phrases. However, the list contains a comprehensive vocabulary of words and phrases that will allow you to easily communicate with other players-no matter which language they are using!

There are a lot of Japanese-speaking players in Vana'diel. The auto-translate function enables you to play in the same world as them so you can enjoy the best that online gaming has to offer.

title: FINAL FANTASY XI for Windows Installation Issues
body:
We have become aware that some users may be experiencing difficulties installing FINAL FANTASY XI for Windows. If you experience such problems, please try the following:

- If your computer has another CD-ROM drive, try installing using that drive instead.

- Make sure the drivers of your CD-ROM drive are up to date. Updates should be available from the manufacturer's website.

- Make sure the firmware of your CD-ROM drive is up to date. Updates should be available from the manufacturer's website.

- If you have extra space on your hard disk drive, try copying the files from FINAL FANTASY XI Discs 1, 2, and 3 into a folder on your hard drive manually, then start installation by double-clicking the "setup.exe" file.

NOTE: Don't forget to install Disc 4 which contains the Rise of the Zilart and then purchase your Content ID!

- If you are still unable to install, please contact the PlayOnline Information Center for further instructions. Hours and contact information for the PlayOnline Information Center are as follows:

PlayOnline Information Center
(858) 790-7529 (PLAY)
Monday through Friday
9:00 am to 6:00 pm Pacific Time

We will be happy to assist you.

title: Applying for World Emigration (11/21)
body:
In response to the increase in World population, we are inviting players to emigrate to different Worlds. Please read the following carefully. If you wish to emigrate, please follow the instructions below.

[World Emigration Guidelines]

Applicable Worlds:

-All Worlds

Application Period:

From 11/21/2003 01:00 (PST) until 11/29/2003 07:00 (PST)

Regarding new World implementation and emigration:

-Details regarding whether or not the emigration will take place, the date and time of emigration, the number of new Worlds created, and details about the configuration of new Worlds will be based on the outcome of the recruitment. There will be an announcement at a later time.

-3 new Worlds are scheduled to be created. In the event that applicants are divided among multiple Worlds, all applicants from a single World will be moved into the same new World.

-In the event that the number of players who wish to emigrate to the new World does not fill up one whole World, the World shift will be postponed.


How to apply for World emigration:

When the application period begins, an NPC called the World Shifter will appear in each of the following areas. By talking to this NPC, you can apply for or cancel World emigration, and confirm your character's emigration status. Please read the World Shifter's responses carefully before submitting an application.

Ru'Lude Gardens (I-10)
Port San d'Oria (I-8)
Port Bastok (L-8)
Windurst Walls (G-6)

*Note: After the application deadline, you will be unable to make any further requests for World emigration.

How to confirm your World emigration status:

During the application period, a login message will appear indicating your World emigration status. If you are already logged in, you can view this message by entering "/smes". Please be sure to confirm your status before the end of the application period.

*Message displayed when applying for World emigration:
"You have submitted an application for World emigration."

*Message displayed when not applying for World emigration:
"You have not submitted an application for World emigration."

CAUTION:

If you are considering applying for World emigration, please read the following points to ensure a smooth transition.

When emigrating:
Emigration of characters is done one at a time. If you request emigration for any of your other characters, please conduct all applications separately.


Character name:
If your character happens to have the same name as another player in the World to which you emigrate, you will have to change your name before entering that World. If you need to change your name, your name will be shown in yellow, and you must follow the on-screen instructions. This name change will not affect your Friend List.

Delivery Box/Auction items:
All items up for auction and in your Delivery Box will be lost when you emigrate. Please collect these items before moving. Any items in your Mog Safe will be transported with you to the new world.

Regarding used linkshells:
Following a World shift, your linkshells will be automatically exchanged with new, unopened linkshells. If you have an unused linkshell, you may bring it to the new World. If a linkshell owner emigrates, the player's old linkshell will be deactivated and a new unopened linkshell will be automatically provided.

title: Frequently Asked Questions about World Emigration
body:
The following is a compilation of frequently asked questions regarding World emigration. Before preparing for World emigration, please refer to the following.

Question:
Will I be able to continue with any of my ongoing Quests?
Will I be able to keep my Conquest Points and Rank Points?

Answer:
Your character status will be carried over to the new World.
This includes levels, skills (battle, magic, synthesis), gil, items, Mog House's Mog Safe and layout, gardening status, home point, home country or mission rank, conquest points, etc. Your PlayOnline friend list, email, album, etc. will not change.

Question:
Will all characters applying be able to emigrate?

Answer:
All characters that applied during the application period will emigrate.  Depending on the application turnout, it is possible that your character will be reallocated or merged into another World.

Question:
When is the application deadline?
What will happen if I barely make the application process?

Answer:
On November 29th, 2003 at 7:00 (PST), the World Shifter from each World will disappear thus ending application. If you are in process of applying right before this time, the latest World emigration status will be saved. When the World Shifter disappears you will not be able to confirm your changes therefore be sure to take adequate time when finishing your application. There can be no more changes after the application deadline.

Question:
Is there any cost for World emigration?

Answer:
No. Any character can apply for free.

Question:
When I emigrate to the new World, where is my starting point?

Answer:
You will start from the last position you logged out from.  There are no changes with your home point.

title: On the Use of "Speedhack" Third-Party Tools
body:
We have recently confirmed that it is possible to make characters in FINAL FANTASY XI move faster than intended by using certain other software applications.

Whether intentional or not, it is a violation of the PlayOnline User Agreements and Policies to use any program other than those offered or approved by Square-Enix USA, Inc. or to exit and misuse the game system from the outside. Such violations are punishable by account cancellation, and we ask that all users refrain from this kind of behavior. Also in accordance with our policies, users whose accounts are cancelled in this manner are prohibited from any and all subsequent use of the PlayOnline service.

Currently, a solution designed to stop such behavior at its source is under development.  However, we are still conducting investigations into unusual gameplay behavior, and anyone caught using any illegal third-party application will be subject to punishment, even if they are unaware such applications are running or are not allowed.

If you believe your character is moving at unusually accelerated speeds, please stop all related applications or devices that may be affecting  gameplay.  If the situation does not change, please petition a GM.

If you should spot another player moving in a strange fashion, unless that player's actions are directly impeding your use of FINAL FANTASY XI, it is not necessary to petition a GM about the situation.

We thank you for your cooperation in helping us to ensure fair, balanced, and quality gameplay.

title: On the Conditions Necessary for Riding a Chocobo
body:
In the most recent FINAL FANTASY XI update, we added a small change to the conditions necessary for riding a chocobo.

The Update Details read, "The level restriction for riding chocobos in the three main nations has been decreased to 15. However, the amount of riding time for characters lower than level 20 will be shortened."

The phrasing here is misleading. In order to ride a chocobo at level 15, it is still necessary to acquire a chocobo license in the same way under the same conditions as before the update.

Accordingly, characters who have not yet completed the quest to acquire a chocobo license will not be able to ride a chocobo at level 15. Further, the requirements for completing the quest have not been lowered to 15.

Finally, as reported earlier, chocobo ride time for characters level 15 to 19 is limited to 15 minutes.

We apologize for the lack of clarity in the Update Details, and for any inconvenience this has caused.

title: PlayOnline GM Call Beta Opens!
body:
We have released a new GM Call function accessible from the PlayOnline Viewer. This function is for services including PlayOnline Viewer inquiries but not related to FINAL FANTASY XI.

When making a GM petition from the PlayOnline Viewer, you will be able to describe your issues with PlayOnline, technical issues with PlayOnline applications, make reports on any disturbances caused by other users, etc.  This service will connect you to a text-based chat form where you can speak directly with a Game Master.

Before making a petition, please check the Q&A database first to see whether your question has already been answered. The Q&A database is available from both the PlayOnline Viewer and the official FINAL FANTASY XI web site (http://www.playonline.com/ff11us/index.html). If you still cannot find an answer to your question, please feel free to request a GM's assistance during gameplay.


If you still cannot find an answer to your question, please feel free to request a GM's assistance during gameplay.

We ask that you do not make a GM Call for any of the following:

- Ideas and suggestions
- License agreement issues
- Issues you encounter before logging in to PlayOnline
- Previously reported issues (including scheduled maintenance)

Instead, please use the designated mail forms or contact the PlayOnline Information Center about such matters.

*Regarding FINAL FANTASY XI related petitions, please make your petition within the game whenever possible.

There are cases where your petition will be closed based on the details in your petition description.

To help us better assist you, be sure to make a detailed report in your petition description.  If you believe your issue was not resolved due a lack of detail in the description, please try again with more details.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation!

title: Pernicious Presents
body:
Since the decoration of the three nations for the holiday season, the trees around town have attracted record crowds. Vana'diel appears to be shaded by the twin branches of peace and harmony...

However, according to the latest breaking news, the trees donated to each nation of Vana'diel last year by Windurst's Rhinostery are running amok and causing all sorts of havoc!

"Disposing of those trees should have been mere routine,
but they woke from their stasis, and boy, are they mean!
Talk to a moogle to lend us a hand,
and battle the menace that threatens the land.
More than ten of them are on the rampage, I fear!
These "Twinkling Treants" are ruining the New Year!"
says a representative of the Rhinostery.

Twinkling Treant sightings continue to pour in from all over the world.  Find out more about the arboreal situation from your local Moogles and help cut down these bothersome botanical beasts!


[Participation Details:]

- The right to participate in this event can be acquired from Moogles dispatched to various areas throughout the nations.

- This right will become invalid after a certain amount of time. 
It can also be forfeited by speaking to one of these Moogles again.

- A level restriction will be imposed while participating in the event. The level restriction differs between regions and, if you are equipped with items higher than the level restriction, they will automatically be unequipped.

- If you are defeated by a Twinkling Treant you will only lose experience points if you were not participating in the event.  But be warned, experience points will be lost as usual if you are defeated by monsters unrelated to this event. 

- Assuming they meet the necessary requirements, other players, parties, and alliances will be able to attack any Twinkling Treant you are engaging without being asked for help.  These treants do not drop items. 

- Defeat all the Twinkling Treants to receive a special surprise!

*This event is currently underway.

title: Teleport Service Opened!
body:
Congratulations, citizens of Fenrir! You are the first to have succeeded at removing all of the Twinkling Treants.

On Fenrir, where all the Twinkling Treants were successfully removed, members of the trader's guild have been dispatched to the three Kingdoms of San d'Ordia, Bastok, and Windurst as well as the outposts of each region. A teleport service is scheduled to open and provide continuous service.

Once special conditions have been met, the dispatches from the guild will provide a warp from the outposts in each region back to the players' country of origin, and from the country out to the outposts in each region.

However, the teleport service is not operating in those worlds where the Twinkling Treants are yet to be removed.

Once the removal of all Twinkling Treants is complete, the teleport service will open.  So combine your strength and fight hard to complete the removal!


On the Usage of the Teleport Service:

- In order to take advantage of the teleport service, it is necessary to fulfill the following two requirements.  One, the refueling quest to the desired region must be completed. Two, the character's job level must be above that specified by each region.

- The positions and names of the Teleport Service dispatch are as follows:

Port Windurst: (D-5) Rottata
North San d'Oria: (D-9) Jeanvirgaud
Bastok Metalworks: (F-8) Conrad

- Please take note that the teleport service cannot be used through talking to a Teleport Dispatch outside of one's home country. 

- The Teleport Service requires a usage fee. This fee changes as depending on the desired region of transfer and the condition of the Empire.

- In regards to the refueling quest, even if the quest has been received before, after the opening day of the Teleport Service on this world, it is necessary to complete the refueling quest once again.

- In the event that one has applied to move from their home country, the results of the refueling quest do not transfer with them to the other country.

- A technical issue has been confirmed wherein characters whose level is under 20, upon talking to the Teleport Dispatch, regardless of having completed the refueling quest receive the message, "At present, as there are no regions for whom the refueling quest has been completed, we regret to inform you that we are unable to provide teleport service."

*This issue is scheduled to be fixed in the upcoming update.

title: PlayOnline Users Break 500,000 Barrier!
body:
The PlayOnline service has surpassed 500,000 registered users in North America and Japan combined, with the total online community population (number of active characters) of FINAL FANTASY XI at nearly one million characters.

Since its inception in May of 2002 for the PlayStation(R)2 platform, followed shortly by the Windows version in November of the same year, PlayOnline has continued to grow explosively. This growth heralded the release of the North American Windows version in October of 2003.

2004 looks to continue this trend, with the scheduled release of the North American PlayStation(R)2 version in March, which will spearhead our policy of bringing cross-continent, cross-platform entertainment to the global market.

title: PlayOnline Plus Beta Test Begins
body:
PlayOnline is proud to announce three new mail services, known collectively as PlayOnline Plus. We are now accepting applications to participate in the beta test, which begins today.

[Character Name Address]
You can now have up to five PlayOnline e-mail addresses based on the names of your characters. This service is currently available for FINAL FANTASY XI characters.

FINAL FANTASY XI example:

xxx@yyy.ffxi.pol.com

(Here, "xxx" represents the name of your character and "yyy" represents the name of your world.)

* While this service increases the number of sender addresses available to you, it does not create new mail accounts. Mail using a character name address is handled through your original PlayOnline mail account.

This can be useful if, for example, you would rather not disclose your primary PlayOnline address to someone. You can simply use a character name address instead.


[Mail Forwarding]
This service forwards mail that is sent to your PlayOnline address to up to two other e-mail addresses.


[Mail Filter]
This service allows you to block unwanted mail based on sender or subject.

We can accept up to 3,000 beta testers for each PlayOnline Plus service.

Beta testers will need Content IDs for each service that they test. All PlayOnline Plus Content IDs will be free of charge for the duration of the beta test (approximately two months). To apply for the beta test, select "Extras" from the PlayOnline Viewer's main menu, then select "PlayOnline Plus." To acquire Content IDs, visit the Content ID page for each service that interests you.

* Because PlayOnline Plus is still under development, errors may occur. To report any such issues, please visit the PlayOnline Plus top page and select "Report a Bug."

title: Character Recovery Support Now Available
body:
We have recently received many inquiries concerning the recovery of deleted characters. After a discussion with our development team and administrative staff, we have decided to introduce a character recovery support service.

Players who apply must agree to the terms and conditions below before contacting the Information Center for support.

We will start accepting applications for character recovery from 1/28/2004. Please note that we will not accept applications before the above date.

* As stated in the character deletion warning message, deleted character data is treated as "permanently lost". We typically do not accept character recovery requests. Please use extreme caution when deleting your characters.
* This one-time support option is currently offered free of charge. However, this support may be fee-based in the future.

[Conditions for Recovery]
- Recovery is only available once per PlayOnline ID, with a limit of 16 characters.
- In the best-case scenario, the character can be restored to its state immediately prior to deletion.
- Character(s) deleted more than 3 months ago will not be covered by this service.
- If the applicant or a third party has created another character with the same name, then the restored character's name must be changed.

* Please contact us to confirm if character data can be recovered.
* We cannot return any items that were on auction or in the delivery box prior to deletion.
* Please refer to the Q&A section for more information. You can find it by selecting [Q&A] => [Q&A Database] followed by Number [Q12158] and [Q12457] from the FINAL FANTASY XI title page.
* Please note that under certain conditions, the recovery service may be unavailable even if the applicant is eligible.

***************************************
PlayOnline Information Center
(858) 790-7529 (PLAY)
Monday through Friday
9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time

title: Connection Error Follow-up Notice
body:
On 1/16/2004, we received several complaints regarding connection errors with the game servers.

Upon closer examination, we found that the problem was the result of severe network congestion.

We have consequently increased the number of servers in order to distribute the heavy load. We hope to avoid similar errors in the future, and we will continue to closely monitor server activity.

All servers are currently stable, and normal play may continue.

* Please note that due to the nature of online gaming, temporary connection issues may still occur depending on a player's network environment.

After the investigation is completed, we will continue to add more hardware to further stabilize our servers in order to provide a better gaming environment for our users.

We apologize for any inconvenience.

title: PlayOnline Plus Service Begins(2/26)
body:
PlayOnline Plus services go live on Thursday, February 26, 2004 at 1:30 (PST).

PlayOnline Plus
* Monthly fees are shown below.

Friend List Plus: No Charge

Friend List Plus offers web access to several features of the PlayOnline Friend List, including online status and messages.

You can access Friend List Plus from the official FINAL FANTASY XI web site.

This service is available to all PlayOnline members at no charge.

* Friend List Plus is accessible via web browser only.


Character Name Addresses: $3 Per Month

You can now have up to five PlayOnline e-mail addresses based on the names of your characters. This service is currently available for FINAL FANTASY XI characters.

FINAL FANTASY XI example:
xxx@yyy.ffxi.pol.com
(Here, "xxx" represents the name of your character and "yyy" represents the name of your World.)

* While this service increases the number of sender addresses available to you, it does not create new mail accounts. Mail using a character name address is handled through your original PlayOnline mail account.

This can be useful if, for example, you would rather not disclose your primary PlayOnline address to someone. You can simply use a character name address instead.


Mail Forwarding: $1 Per Month

This service forwards mail that is sent to your PlayOnline address to up to two other e-mail addresses.


Mail Filter: No Charge

The mail filter allows you to block unwanted mail. You can filter mail based on sender address or subject, and specify up to twenty different filtering conditions for each type.


To Beta Test Participants:

Beta testers for character name addresses or mail forwarding can transfer their data to the live service if they purchase a Content ID before the end of May 2004. To transfer the data, visit the corresponding service's Content ID page, select "Carry Over ID," and follow the instructions displayed. Character name addresses and mail forwarding data must be transferred separately. The mail filter, however, requires no additional registration and is ready for use.

To visit the PlayOnline Plus pages, select "Extras" from the PlayOnline main menu, then select "PlayOnline Plus."

Be sure to also check out the PlayOnline Plus page at PlayOnline.com.

title: "Hina-Matsuri"
body:
The flowers are blooming and spring has finally arrived in the three nations of San d'Oria, Bastok, and Windurst.

Underneath the flowered trees, you'll find beautifully constructed crafts resembling Tarutaru folding screens, and workbenches covered in elegant crimson tapestries. These venerable works of art have been put on display by various local craftsmen.

These items have been designed by the craftsmen of the Carpenters' Guild based on adventurers' tales of a festival called Hina-Matsuri: a celebration held in countries to the far east. The Culinarians' Guild has also gathered together to celebrate, and are creating dishes to fit the occasion.

While little is known of this festival's background, the inhabitants of Vana'diel treat it as a celebration of growth and observe it every year.

So sit back, relax, and enjoy the Far Eastern atmosphere while taking in the beauty of the peach-colored blossoms and the many finely crafted decorations.

title: Safekeeping of Your PlayOnline ID and Password
body:
In order to enjoy PlayOnline services, each individual customer has their own unique registration codes that are included with the FINAL FANTASY XI package. Without these codes, you will not be able to use PlayOnline services, and therefore it is very important that you keep them in a safe place.

Game Masters (GMs) and/or Square Enix staff will never ask for your PlayOnline ID or password during gameplay or through e-mail.
*The only exception is when talking to a PlayOnline Information Center representative, you may be asked for the PlayOnline ID or registration code.

Using third-party programs may expose your PlayOnline ID and password without your knowledge. Be very careful when using your PlayOnline ID and password. Be sure to use it only when logging into PlayOnline and/or PlayOnline Plus. 

Also, please make use of the Guest Login function when you attempt to log into the game from either your friend's PC or an Internet Cafe.

Finally, it is recommended that you change your PlayOnline password on a regular basis.  This can be done through the "Service & Support" screen accessed from the PlayOnline Menu. Choose "Membership," select "PlayOnline ID," and then select "Change Password".

title: Harkening of Spring
body:
The cities of all three nations were awash with the bloom of flowers following the "Hina-Matsuri" event. Even the Moogles are in high spirits with the sight of Springs' beauty.

In fact, it seems that they have hidden a surprise near the many flowers blooming across all three nations. One scrappy youngster from North San d'Oria who found one of the hidden surprises exclaimed "Holy Mithra! That's so cool! It's like so... beautiful...!"

On the other hand, rumors abound of Rhinostery members heaving a sigh of relief that the flowers have bloomed without the trees running amuck. Perhaps they had something to do with the recent wave of blooming flowers? 

Adventurers and travelers among the three nations, take in the coming of Spring and enjoy yourselves!

title: Egg Hunt Egg-stravaganza
body:
Did you hear the news?  The Moogles of Vana'diel have been playing with something egg-straordinary. You have a chance to collect eggs, as well as mix and match according to various rules! Let's see what you can find at the "Egg Hunt"!

Within a limited time period, you will be able to collect eggs known as "initial eggs." If you find the correct combination of eggs, you may receive an eggs-tra surprise!

So lets start collecting those initial eggs! A letter of the alphabet is carved on the surface of each initial egg. There is one for every letter of the alphabet!

The easiest way to get ahold of these eggs is by speaking to the Moogles in San d'Oria, Windurst, and Bastok. Bear in mind that you can only receive one free egg per day (Vana'diel time).

Also, when you want more initial eggs, try trading other types of eggs to the Moogles. But remember, you can only try this once a day as well. Moogles seem to like some eggs more than others. Try trading different numbers of different eggs and see what you can recieve!

If you have enough initial eggs in hand, you will be able to trade with other adventurers and try the "First 3" challenge! Combine the correct letters and give them to the Moogle. If you are successful in making a "First 3," you'll be awarded a wonderful prize.

In addition, there are all kinds of rules in play for the Egg Hunt.  Rumor has it that there are plenty of hidden elements to this event, including secret combinations and more! Moogles may give you clues, so make sure you ask!

The egg-citement begins on April 8th, 2004 at 8:00 (PDT) and continues until April 13th, 2004 at 0:00 (PDT). Now's your chance to join in with the Moogles, so don't miss out!

title: Straight from the Adventurer's Mouth!
body:
May 16th, 2004 will mark the second anniversary of FINAL FANTASY XI's official launch in Japan. To mark the occasion, the Vana'diel Tribune editorial staff is seeking YOUR opinion!

[Details]
In approximately ten words, write about your adventuring life so far, your dreams and hopes as an adventurer, or anything else you'd like to put down for your fellow adventurers to see.

* Submissions may be edited for length or content.
* Authors yield all copyrights to SQUARE ENIX upon
  submission.

[How to Apply]
Please fill out the required information listed below and send it to the following e-mail address via your PlayOnline e-mail account:

tribune@us.playonline.com

* Only one entry per character will be accepted.

[Required Information]
- Character Name
- World Name
- PlayOnline E-mail Address
- Your comments (10 words or less)

[Application Period]
4/30/2004 to 5/5/2004

Selected comments will be published in future issues of the Vana'diel Tribune, so feel free put your thoughts down and send them to us!

title: FINAL FANTASY XI Second Anniversary Event
body:
It's been two exciting years since FINAL FANTASY XI launched in Japan--and in celebration, the moogles have prepared a special anniversary surprise for the adventurers of Vana'diel!

This event is scheduled to last for 8 days, from 5/8 8:00 PDT until 5/15 8:00 PDT.

With the help of the moogles, adventurers will be able to reflect on their careers and look ahead to the future. But what previously unseen information will the moogles be willing to share?

We will also be conducting the Fourth Vana'diel Survey to help commemorate this anniversary event.

title: Temporary Suspension of GM Service (5/8)

body:
At the following time, we will be performing system update maintenance on FINAL FANTASY XI. During this period, FINAL FANTASY XI will be unavailable. Thank you for your patience.

*There will also be a client update to follow. Please select the "Play" button after the maintenance and follow the instructions on your screen to begin the update process.

[Date & Time]
05/17/2004 from 10:00 to 13:00 (PDT)

*Maintenance completion time may be subject to change.

[Affected Services]
FINAL FANTASY XI

[Important Update Details]

*The following changes and corrections have been made to Ballista:

-An issue concerning an incorrect level restriction announced by the Herald for matches that carry over from one month to another has been corrected.

-The restriction that prevented characters from participating in Ballista more than once per day (Earth time) has been removed.

-The maximum difference allowed in the number of people participating on each side has been altered from 6 to the following:

          Participants   Maximum Difference
          6-11               1
          12-17             2
          18-23             3
          24-29             4
          29+                5
  
*This restriction will now be based on the side with the least number of participants.

-The ??? mark that appears after defeating the bosses in each of the six areas of Dynamis is now easier to target. This mark has been given priority in the targeting order so it will be displayed even when standing in a large crowd of characters.

*The following item issues have been corrected:

Bard's Slippers
-> An issue concerning the "string instrument skill" bonus not functioning correctly has been addressed.

Suppanomimi
-> An issue concerning the "dual wield skill" bonus not functioning correctly has been addressed.

-An issue concerning the quest "Fit for a Prince" being re-offered after the quest has been completed will no longer occur.

-Various other issues will be corrected.

title: Closing PlayOnline Plus Beta Test Data Transfer (5/31)
body:
We will be concluding the transfer of character name addresses and mail forwarding data for the PlayOnline Plus Beta Test on 5/31/2004 at 21:00 (PDT). Also, starting from the above date, the "Carry over ID" option will no longer be available.

Users who have participated in the character name address and mail transfer function beta test may be able to carry over their settings via the "Carry over ID" process. Users who wish to use this service are advised to do so before 5/31.

* Please note that you will be unable to carry over any settings if you have already purchased a new Content ID.

[To carry over beta test data]
You may do so by selecting the "Carry over ID" in the Content ID section, accessible from the PlayOnline Plus menu.

This process is required if you wish to carry over both your character name address and mail forwarding settings and data. However, it is not necessary to re-register in order to receive or reject mail.

You can access the PlayOnline Plus page by selecting "Extras,"
followed by "PlayOnline Plus" from the PlayOnline main menu.

For more details, please refer to the PlayOnline Plus information page at (http://www.playonline.com/polplusus/intro/).

We hope you enjoy our new PlayOnline Plus services.

title: Technical Issue Identified
body:
The following technical error has been identified and will be fixed in the future version update.

*This issue was fixed as of the version update that occured on 6/3 at 2:00 PDT

- An issue involving a forced quit to Windows when certain monsters use their special attacks (i.e. the Tonberries' "Throat Stab") has been identified.

This issue only occurs on the Windows version when the following effect filters (found in the Main Menu under Config) are turned on:

Monster --> you
Monster --> monster
Monster --> party
Monster --> non-party PC

To avoid such trouble, we suggest that you leave the above-mentioned filters off until the version update has been implemented.

We apologize for any inconvenience.

*Previously, this news item indicated that only the "Monster --> you" filter need be turned off, when in fact all of the "Monster" filters must be turned off in order for this solution to work properly. This has now been amended, and we apologize for the confusion.

title: Special Rules for Ballista
body:
The next Ballista event will feature special rules as detailed below.


Special Rules
-------------
(1) The number of Petras that can be scored at once will be set to five. Additionally a time limit will be imposed on Gate Breach status.

(2) Participants outside of the nation listed on the match card may join. However a certain amount of time will have to pass before that participant may join.

(3) The potency of Sleep will be decreased.

(4) The effective radius of Gate Breach status will be increased to 30 yalms on party members.

(5) Damage and accuracy values between characters of different levels will be changed. As of this event, your damage and attack will increase when you attacking a player who is a higher level than yourself.

(6) The maximum number of participants for one team has been increased from 36 to 72.

(7) Those adventurers not participating in Ballista will NOT be displayed.

You can confirm these rules by talking to a Pursuivant. Be sure to confirm the entry period as well as allegiance and level restrictions before entering.

title: Details on Current Known Issues
body:
Since the implement of the latest version update on Jun. 29, 2004, several game play and system related issues have been discovered. A new update to address these issues has been made and is currently being tested. Players will be informed as soon as a download date has been set.


-An issue in which monsters appearing in garrison battles would not disappear after the quest ended.

-An issue in which monsters' names would be red or purple the moment they appeared, preventing players from immediately attacking them.

-An issue limiting the types of monsters that can be caught while fishing, resulting in the inability to receive items necessary for certain quests.

-An issue causing the range of certain spells and abilities to be shorter than usual.

-An issue preventing players from attacking Old Sabertooth, located in the Sauromugue Champaign.

-An issue preventing certain monsters in Dynamis - Xarcabard from using their special abilities.

These issues were addressed in the Jul. 6, 2004 version update at approximately 10:00 (PDT).

We apologize for any inconvenience.

title: Summerfest!
body:
Spring is over and it's time for Summerfest!

At this time every year, adventurers gather in the towns to kick back and take a break from their usual daily activities. It is a time for players from all nations to come together and swap tales of their exploits.

However, night is when Summerfest really heats up. The ensuing darkness sets the stage for a grand display of fireworks in the sky and on the ground. Countless bazaars line the streets and music fills the air. Adventurers of all shapes and sizes strike up conversations with complete strangers when not dancing hand in hand with their companions.

The Moogles, as well, have devoted themselves to making this summer a memorable one. Participate in their events to receive wonderful items that will make your Summerfest even more exciting!

title: Take your shot at "Goldfish Scooping"!
body:
With Summerfest kicking into high gear across various lands, it appears
that the merchants have been getting into the festive spirit as well,
offering various new items.

Those familiar with the customs of different lands say that the equipment
the merchants sell may be of an Eastern origin. Curiously, the goods
closely resemble the items used in an event known as Goldfish Scooping.

Goldfish Scooping is a traditional game often played during the summer
months. People use fragile "scoops" to skim the water in order to catch
as many brilliantly colored goldfish as they can--before the paper on
the scoops rips.

Trading goldfish to a merchant will earn you points based on the type of
fish you catch. These points can be exchanged for a plethora of exciting
Summerfest items.

So if you hear one of these peddlers, you know what to do! Go and give
Goldfish Scooping a try! Who knows, you might just get hooked!

The NPCs will be at:

West Ronfaure     G-10
South Gustaberg   E-8
East Sarutabaruta H-8
Rabao             F-7

-About reopening the "Test of Courage" event

The Test of Courage event was brought to a close as the Goldfish Scooping event opened. However, due to the popularity of the event, we have decided to reopen it, and have the event run until the end of Summerfest.

Take your best shot at both events, and above all, have fun!

We apologize for the delay in announcing the end of the previous Test of Courage event, and any inconvenience we may have caused.

If this issue is affecting you, then it will be necessary for you to reconfigure your security settings to allow the PlayOnline Viewer to pass through your firewall. Please consult your security software manual for more details.

title: Message To Windows XP Users
body:
Due to the firewall function of Windows XP Service Pack 2 which was recently released by Microsoft, a dialog may appear when you attempt to use the PlayOnline Viewer or FINAL FANTASY XI. If such a dialog appears, please select "Unblock" and you will be able to continue to play normally. This dialog can also appear after returning to the PlayOnline Viewer (in windowed mode) from FINAL FANTASY XI.

If "Keep Blocking" is selected, you may become unable to connect. By performing the following steps, it is possible to "Unblock" PlayOnline and FINAL FANTASY XI.

1. From the Start menu, select Start -> Control Panel and select "Windows Firewall."
2. Click the "Exceptions" tab to display the application registration screen.
3. If "PlayOnline Viewer" is displayed on the list, check the box next to it. If "PlayOnline Viewer" is not displayed, select "Add Program" and register the POL.EXE file from the folder where you installed PlayOnline.
4. Select "OK" and exit the "Windows Firewall" to complete the process.

For further details regarding Windows XP Service Pack 2, please see the below Microsoft web page.

http://www.microsoft.com/windowsxp/sp2/default.mspx

title: Special Rule for Ballista(8/27)
body:
Ballista will now feature a special rule as detailed below.

*This rule will apply until Sept. 12 8:00 (PDT).

Please take a moment to enjoy playing Ballista with a twist! Don't miss out!

Special Rule
-------------
Previously, Ballista has used a single victory per series system. Now, each series will use a "best two of three" system. One match will take seven Vana'diel hours (19 minutes Earth time), and there will be a 1.5 Vana'diel hour (four minutes Earth time) intermission between matches. See the following table for a complete match schedule.

1st match 7 hours
Intermission 1.5 hours
2nd match 7 hours
Intermission 1.5 hours
3rd match 7 hours

In the event that each team wins one of the first two matches, whichever team wins the third match shall be the winner of that series.

However, if the same team wins the first and second matches, the following condition shall also apply: A team that wins the third match and has the top-scoring player shall be awarded two match points. This means that it is possible to force a draw even if your team loses the first two matches.

You can confirm this rule by talking to a Pursuivant. Be sure to confirm the entry period as well as allegiance and level restrictions before entering.

title: Special Rules for Ballista(8/30)
body:
The next Ballista event will feature additional special rules in addition to the "best two of three" system currently in place.
Be sure not to miss your chance to take advantage of these special rules!


Special Rules
------------------
(1) The number of Petras that can be scored at once will be set to five. Additionally, a time limit will be imposed on Gate Breach status.

(2) The potency of Sleep will be decreased.

(3) The effective radius of Gate Breach status will be increased to 30 yalms on party members.

(4) Damage and accuracy values between characters of different levels will be changed. As of this event, your damage and attack will increase when you attack a player who is a higher level than yourself.

(5) The maximum number of participants for one team has been increased from 36 to 72.

(6) Those adventurers not participating in Ballista will NOT be displayed.

You can confirm these rules by talking to a Pursuivant. Be sure to confirm the entry period as well as allegiance and level restrictions before entering.

title: Correction To Special Rule
body:
There was a mistake in a particular part of the previous news detailing the new "Best two of three" system. The correct information is as follows.

[Special Rules]
"A team that wins the third match and has the top-scoring player shall be awarded two match points."

It was then stated that in order for this to apply that " the same team win the first and second matches." This statement was erroneous.

The correct condition is as follows:
Regardless of the outcome of the first or second matches, if a team wins the third match and has the top-scoring player, they shall be awarded two match points.

In other words, if the score is 2-0, and the losing team manages to win the third match, then they can tie the game with an overall score of 2-2. However, by the same token, if the winning team wins the third match by the conditions mentioned above, then they can win with an overall score of 4-0.

We apologize for any confusion this may have caused.

title: Applying for World Emigration (Sep. 22)
body:
The commencement of European FINAL FANTASY XI service has increased the overall population during peak times. Though the servers are able to cope with the added load, we have noticed that the peak population at 7:00 (PDT) has increased drastically, with more Japanese and North American players joining the game. For this reason, we have decided to invite players to emigrate to different Worlds to help balance the overall population. Please read the following carefully. If you wish to emigrate, please follow the instructions below.

*Currently, access peak fluctuations for the European version are within acceptable levels.

[World Emigration Guidelines]

Applicable Worlds:

-All Worlds

Application Period:

From Sep. 22, 2004 02:00 (PDT) until Oct. 3, 2004 8:00  (PDT)

Regarding new World implementation and emigration:

-Details regarding whether or not the emigration will take place, the date and time of emigration, the number of new Worlds created, and details about the configuration of new Worlds will be based on the outcome of the recruitment. There will be an announcement at a later time.

-3 new Worlds are scheduled to be created. In the event that applicants are divided among multiple Worlds, all applicants from a single World will be moved into the same new World.

-In the event that the number of players who wish to emigrate to the new World does not fill up one whole World, the World shift will be postponed.


How to apply for World emigration:

When the application period begins, an NPC called the World Shifter will appear in each of the following areas. By talking to this NPC, you can apply for or cancel World emigration, and confirm your character's emigration status. Please read the World Shifter's responses carefully before submitting an application.

Ru'Lude Gardens (I-10)
Port San d'Oria (I-8)
Port Bastok (L-8)
Windurst Walls (G-6)

*Note: After the application deadline, you will be unable to make any further requests for World emigration.

How to confirm your World emigration status:

During the application period, a login message will appear indicating your World emigration status. If you are already logged in, you can view this message by entering "/smes". Please be sure to confirm your status before the end of the application period.

*Message displayed when applying for World emigration:
"You have submitted an application for World emigration."

*Message displayed when not applying for World emigration:
"You have not submitted an application for World emigration."

CAUTION:

If you are considering applying for World emigration, please read the following points to ensure a smooth transition.

When emigrating:
Emigration of characters is done one at a time. If you request emigration for any of your other characters, please conduct all applications separately.


Character name:
If your character happens to have the same name as another player in the World to which you emigrate, you will have to change your name before entering that World. If you need to change your name, your name will be shown in yellow, and you must follow the on-screen instructions. This name change will not affect your Friend List.

Delivery Box/Auction items:
All items up for auction and in your Delivery Box will be lost when you emigrate. Please collect these items before moving. Any items in your Mog Safe will be transported with you to the new world.

Regarding used linkshells:
Following a World shift, your linkshells will be automatically exchanged with new, unopened linkshells. If you have an unused linkshell, you may bring it to the new World. If a linkshell owner emigrates, the player's old linkshell will be deactivated and a new unopened linkshell will be automatically provided.

Note that changing names will not destroy your Friend List or any other related data.

-Items in Delivery Boxes or on auction
Any items that are up for auction or stored in your Delivery Box will be destroyed at the time of emigration. We ask that you remove all items from these locations and store them in your character's inventory, or inside your Mog Safe.

-Used linkshells
Linkpearls or pearlsacks cannot be transferred over and will be destroyed in the emigration process. However, the linkshell owner will automatically receive a new linkshell upon arrival in the new World.

title: Trick or Treat!!
body:
Greetings, fellow adventurers!
The Harvest Festival is here once again!

Vana'diel's Harvest Festival is all about townsfolk masquerading as ghosts, scaring passersby, and collecting more treats than the next person!

The people who scared you last year are scrambling about to prepare for this year's event.

If you see anyone dressed up for the event, try trading them treats! They may surprise you with a scare!

One kid in Windurst said, "Ooooh, I'm gonna gather so many treats this year! I wonder what I should do to the adventurer who gives me smelly faerie apples instead of some real goodies... Hee-hee-hee..."

Now gather up some sweets and enjoy this event along with Vana'diel's scariest ghosts!

  [Event]
-The event will be held from Oct. 22, 2004 19:00 (PDT) to around Nov. 1, 2004 0:00 (PST)

  [Participating in the Event]
-The Harvest Festival will take place across the three nations of San d'Oria, Windurst, and Bastok. Walk around town and look for NPCs who are dressed up for the event.

-If you happen to run into one of these townsfolk, don't forget to give him or her a treat! However, don't give the same item to the same person over and over again--how would you feel if you received nothing but hunks of Goblin chocolate? Rather, enjoy the different costumes and give as many different kinds of treats to as many different people as possible!

-Sometimes, certain NPCs will turn you into a monster or beastman upon receiving a treat. While you are masquerading as one of these frightening foes, you will be unable to cast magic or use items. You will also be unable to talk to NPCs, or perform any action that requires targeting, such as opening doors.

-If you would like to cancel the masquerade effect, press the triangle button on your controller or press the "+" key on your keyboard's numeric pad twice. Then, select the "Costume" icon from the status icons located at the top of your screen, and press the X button or the "Enter" key on your keyboard. The masquerade effect will also wear off if you move to another area.

-During the Harvest Festival, the activation requirements for certain items (such as the Trick Staff) will be adjusted.

This is a courtesy notice to help clarify several points about FINAL FANTASY XI Content IDs and PlayOnline accounts.

If you wish to suspend your FINAL FANTASY XI play only temporarily, please cancel your Content ID rather than your PlayOnline account. If you cancel a Content ID, the corresponding character data will be stored for ninety days without any recurring charges. After the ninety-day period has passed, the character data will be deleted and cannot be recovered.

You can extend this period by reactivating the Content ID and then cancelling it again; your character data will then be stored for an additional ninety days. However, please note that the usual monthly charge will apply for the month in which the Content ID was reactivated.

body:

It has been determined that the issue can be rectified by downloading the latest antivirus pattern file for your antivirus software. After updating this file, please restart PlayOnline via the shortcut on your desktop.

Until then, we ask that you do NOT reinstall FINAL FANTASY XI or the PlayOnline viewer, and instead execute FINAL FANTASY XI through the PlayOnline Viewer shortcut.

title: Regarding Real Money Trade (Dec. 8)
body:
With respect to game titles operated by the PlayOnline service, including FINAL FANTASY XI, it is specifically prohibited to sell game currency, characters, or any other in-game items for real money or any other consideration for value (known as Real Money Trade "RMT"). This prohibition is expressly referred to in the following two clauses, which are part of the respective agreements which all registered users of the FINAL FANTASY XI and/or PlayOnline services have agreed to abide by:

*PlayOnline Member Agreement: Article 4.4
*FINAL FANTASY XI User Agreement: Article 3.1

This prohibition is due to the possibility of fraud during transaction in the real world which may lead to legal sanctions, including possible criminal sanctions, being imposed on those involved in such trade. In addition, Real Money Trade was not initially a part of the design for any of our game titles.

We are already investigating this issue and putting into effect appropriate measures for such actions within the game environment, and we will continue to do so in the future. Players found to be participating in Real Money Trade will be deemed to be in breach of the clauses set out above and will be subject to any appropriate legal sanction. We expressly reserve our rights in the event of such a breach, including the right to cancel the PlayOnline account of any user in breach of the clauses above, without any prior notice to such user.

Many of you have recently made GM calls or contacted the Information Center to report such Real Money Trades taking place at various online auction sites. Please note, however, that our ability to take appropriate action in such cases is very often dependent on the cooperation of the respective websites, which is not within our control.  While we are grateful for your help, please note that it is not necessary to make a GM call or to contact the Information Center to report such issues.

While it is not possible to change our policy regarding Real Money Trades for any current online Square Enix title, it is possible that our policy might change for future titles, although no decision in that respect has yet been made.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

title: Anti-Virus Software Issue Uncovered (Dec. 16)
body:
We confirmed an ongoing issue regarding anti-virus software programs that misinterpret certain downloadable files as a virus during the version update for PlayOnline, FINAL FANTASY XI or other PlayOnline contents for the Windows version.

The anti-virus software programs that perform virus scans for unknown files when the function has been activated, would misinterpret certain files as unknown virus patterns.

We cannot confirm the standard criteria with the specific anti-virus software programs, however we always validate the integrity of the downloadable files.

If you encounter this issue, please refer to the current error details before continuing all PlayOnline or FINAL FANTASY XI version updates. For further details about your anti-virus program, please also consult with the manufacturer.

Thank you very much for your understanding.

title: New Year Rivalry: Moogles vs. Goblins?!
body:
The Starlight Celebration was a resounding success. Thanks to your help, the cities of Vana'diel are overflowing with cheer, and smiles have returned to the children's faces.

The moogles, however, seem unusually glum in contrast to the joyful atmosphere.

"There weren't supposed to be so many of them searching for the cards, kupo..."
"Well, we can play that game, too, kupo..."

The chocobo-riding Goblins frantically searching for something outside the city walls appear to be the cause of the moogles' mood.

Try talking to a gloomy moogle and see what you can do to help!


How to Participate:

The moogles have cleverly hidden seven types of Tenshodo trading cards all over Vana'diel and challenged the Goblins to find them.

Try checking the areas of "Overturned Soil" and collect the cards before the Goblins do!

Checking the "Overturned Soil" as a party will increase the number of cards found at one time. Gather as many friends as possible, and help each other collect all seven types!

Once you have a full set of cards, trade them all to the moogles to receive your reward!

title: Warning Regarding PlayOnline ID and Password Fraud
body:
It has come to our attention that some individuals are contacting FINAL FANTASY XI players in-game and referring them to fake websites resembling the official PlayOnline.com (http://www.playonline.com/) site. These sites ask the player to enter their PlayOnline ID and password at the fake website, with the intent of stealing items belonging to the player's character or characters.

We have permanently removed the PlayOnline membership of these players who are responsible for hosting such websites to the attention of the proper authorities, requested further investigation on this issue with the help of the public organization, and have also shut down these sites to protect the FINAL FANTASY XI community.

Please do not become a victim of "phishing." DO NOT disclose your PlayOnline ID or password to anyone other than the official PlayOnline.com (http://www.playonline.com/) website.

*The only exception is when dealing directly with a PlayOnline Information Center representative via the PlayOnline Service & Support Web Chat system. You may be asked for your PlayOnline ID or registration code in such cases.

Also note that no Square Enix representative (Game Master (GM) staff included) will ever ask you to provide your ID or Password from within a game or via e-mail. If you have experienced such issues, please contact our Information Center or the Game Masters (GM) for further consultations.

Keep your data safe! Keep your PlayOnline ID and Password secure!

title: Valentione's Day!
body:
It's here! It's here! The day we've all been waiting for is finally here, kupo!
What day is that, you ask? Why, Valentione's Day, of course!

With either cries of gratitude or whispers of hidden love, now's the time for you to step up and open your heart! And what a better way to say "I love you" than with a one-of-a-kind present crafted with your own two hands, kupo?

Huh? You're not sure what would make the perfect gift? Well, don't fret, because the Moogles of the Mog House Management Union (MHMU) recently gathered and decided we'd do our best to help our masters out, kupo! Soon, we'll be sending a special crystal to the delivery box of every adventurer in Vana'diel. By using this crystal during synthesis, you'll be able to carve your name right into the finished product, kupo!

Once you've done that, all that's left is for you to take your gift to that "special someone," and let your heart do the rest, kupo!

body:

Member Agreement were permanently banned from PlayOnline.

spots of notorious monsters (NM). They also repeatedly performed harassment and MPK actions against other players.

Grief tactics, including harassment, are listed in the PlayOnline Member
Agreement as violations and are not allowed for any reason. Also,
interfering other players' game play in order to monopolize monsters which spawn in hunting spots is not allowed.

Based on the above, we have taken strict actions against players who have
violated the PlayOnline Member Agreement.

If you become a victim of harrasment, please make a GM Call and report the issue directly to a Game Master.

Your understanding and cooperation will help us provide the best experience possible to our players.

title: Special Rules for Ballista
body:
Ballista will now feature special rules as detailed below.
Don't miss this chance to participate in a different kind of game!

[Special Rules/Settings]
(1) If an entry into a match is cancelled, a player will not be able to enter that match again.

(2) If a player from outside the opposing nations wishes to join an open match, they may do so with the following stipulation. If both sides are even, then the joining player may decide which team they wish to play on. If the sides are uneven, however, then the player will automatically be placed into the team with fewer players.

(3) Level restrictions will be implemented as follows, except Level Restriction 30 which can be joined regardless of level as usual:

No Level Restriction     Level 61 and up
Level Restriction 60     Level 51 and up
Level Restriction 50     Level 41 and up
Level Restriction 40     Level 31 and up

(4) The wait time for reusing the Quarry command will be shortened.

(5) The minimum number of Rooks appearing will be increased to two.

(6) Resurrection time will be reduced as follows:
   30 seconds -> 20 seconds
   45 seconds -> 30 seconds
   60 seconds -> 40 seconds
   75 seconds -> 50 seconds
   90 seconds -> 60 seconds

body:

title: The Doll Festival (Feb. 28)
body:
Master, have you ever heard of the Doll Festival, kupo?

The Doll Festival is a Far Eastern celebration where people pray for the health and happiness of girls. During this time, girls are given rice treats to eat, and have a special place to decorate with dolls, kupo.

A festival that provides such a fun opportunity for laughing and playing sounds like a great idea, don't you think, kupo?

You know, since a lot of the lady adventurers out there grew up in the aftermath of the Crystal War, I bet they didn't get a chance to enjoy this festival, kupo...

And that's why the Mog House Management Union has come up with a plan!
We're going to return those lady adventurers to their childhoods, and give them the experience they never had, kupo!

Hm?
You don't think you're up for it? And what about the guy adventurers?
Don't you worry, kupo. Try talking to the moogles in charge of the festival and see what happens!

This time you're in for some real moogle magic, kupo!

-Form a party of 10 and talk to the moogles around town.
You will receive a present in celebration of the Doll Festival!

-The moogles will only consider players in the same area when counting the number of party members.

-Items can only be received from the moogles once every Vana'diel day.

-Characters that have just been created can only receive items from the moogles after one Vana'diel day has passed.
