We apologize for the inconvenience.

?The following issues in the Seekers of Adoulin mission "The Gates" battlefield has been addressed.
- An issue wherein players can enter the battlefield even though they have not met the requirements for entry.
-An issue wherein a summoned Trust is counted as a participant, allowing entry to the battlefield without being in a party.

title: Current Known Issues (Jun. 18)
body:
Currently, the following issues have been confirmed.
We are currently working on a solution, and ask for your patience.

[Current Known Issues]
- An issue wherein casting Trick Attack on a Trust alter ego that has been summoned by the player has no effect.
- An issue wherein if another party member casts Decoy Shot onto a Trust alter ego that has been summoned by the party leader, the spell has no effect.
- An issue wherein if the player zone changes with an avatar summoned, the merit point-obtained Blood Pact ability cannot  be used.
*The Blood Pact ability that was gained through merit points will become usable again if the avatar is briefly dismissed after the zone change, then summoned again.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

title: Regarding Ultimate Game Card and Ultimate Points
body:
This is a notice to all customers who use PlaySpans Ultimate Game Card or UltimatePoints as a method of payment to purchase Crysta.

As you already may be aware, PlaySpan will be retiring the Ultimate Game Card and UltimatePoints. This means these 2 options will no longer be offered as a payment method for purchasing Crysta.

The last day to redeem retail Ultimate Game Card codes will be September 29, 2014 and the last day to redeem your UltimatePoints will be October 31, 2014.

For additional information regarding the retirement of these options, please visit the appropriate link below.

Ultimate Game Card: http://www.ultimategamecard.com/
UltimatePoints: http://www.ultimatepay.com/

In light of this news, we are also working with payment providers to increase the number of payment solutions we can offer.

title: Current Known Issues After the Version Update (Aug. 13)
body:
The following issues have been confirmed after the Aug. 11, 2014 version update.
We are currently working on a solution, and ask for your patience.

[Current Known Issues]
- An issue wherein the Stoneskin effect given by the White Mage ability Afflatus Solace is affected by Curaga and Cura spells.
- An issue wherein, when HP absorption is active from using the Thief ability Mug, the displayed amount of gil acquired is occasionally incorrect.
- An issue occurring after a monsters use of the Dark Magic spell Absorb-Attri wherein the displayed number of status effects absorbed from player characters is incorrect.
- An issue in the Rala Waterways (U) of Alluvion Skirmishes wherein monsters, Noetic Ascensions, and Living Cairns occasionally spawn on the other side of a door that cannot be opened.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

*The above issues were addressed in the maintenance which occurred on Aug. 13, 2014 at 22:00 (PDT).

title: Regarding the Issues Occurring Since August (Sep. 10)
body:
Regarding the area issues we have been experiencing since August, we have confirmed that the problem lies with the data of certain augmented items. When characters possessing these augmented items attempt to take certain actions, this causes the zone server to crash.

We are working as quickly as we can to address this issue; however, it appears that this may take some time. Until then, we plan on implementing temporary measures to primarily keep the servers from crashing. As for the maintenance to implement these temporary measures, we will inform you in a separate notice once the specific date and time has been determined.

We are sorry, but until these temporary measures are in place, if you should be disconnected from the game during play, we ask that you please wait for a while and try logging in again.

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience and understanding.

title: Important Notice to All Software Token Users
body:
If you are using a Software Token, please be sure that you keep your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. If you do not remove your software token from your account beforehand, this password is required to regain access to your account in the following cases:

-You upgrade to a new phone
-You lose your phone
-You delete the application on your phone

You can view your Emergency Removal Password on the top page of the Square Enix account management system (http://account.square-enix.com) after logging in.

If you should find yourself in a situation where you no longer have access to your software token , you can remove it* with the Emergency Removal Password from your account by visiting the following URL and following the on-screen instructions: http://sqex.to/GPE

*Please note that the Emergency Removal Password can only be used once. If you re-register your software token afterwards, you will receive a new Emergency Removal Password.

If you still have your Software Token but wish to remove it from your account, please log in to the Square Enix account management system (http://account.square-enix.com), select One-Time Password followed by Software Token and follow the on-screen instructions.

To re-register a Software Token, please log in to the Square Enix account management system (http://account.square-enix.com), select One-Time Password followed by Software Token and follow the on-screen instructions.

title: Regarding the Issues Occurring Since August : Follow-up
body:
Regarding the area issues we have been experiencing since early August, we implemented temporary measures during the maintenance on Sep. 10, 2014 4:00 (PDT) to prevent area servers from crashing. Because of this temporary solution, however, when characters possessing these augmented items attempted to take certain actions (such as moving the cursor over it in the inventory, selling it, discarding it, or equipping it), this may cause the client to freeze.

We confirmed that the issue is being caused by the following augmented weapons:

Ninzas +2 / Leisilonu +2 / Iztaasu +2 /Crobaci +2 /
Faizzeer +2 / Iclamar +2 / Iizamal +2 /
Qatsunoci +2 / Kannakiri / Shichishito / Aedolt +2 /
Lehbrailg +2 / Uffrat +2 / Bocluamni +2 /
Hgafircian +2 / Firmament / Guisarme / Ribauldequin /
Savate Fists / Vodun Mace / Dire Scythe / Yataghan /
Doom Tabar / Yukitsugu /

* Augmented weapons obtained before the version update on Aug. 12, 2014 are unaffected.

We plan to implement temporary measures to address the client freeze issue in the coming days. We will release further details on this as more information becomes available.

These measures to address the area server crashes and client crashes are only temporary and will be supplanted by more permanent solutions in the near future. We ask for your continued patience and understanding as we work to resolve these issues promptly.

We apologize for any inconveniences this may have caused.

title: Software Token Version Update (Nov. 27)
body:
On Dec. 4, 2014, in order to add usability features such as language selection, the iOS/Android app SQUARE ENIX Software Token will receive a version update.

Current users of the Software Token app should update via the App Store/Google Play as soon as the version update is available.

If you are unable to perform the version update normally after Dec. 4, you will need your Emergency Removal Password to remove the Software Token linked to your account before uninstalling and reinstalling the app.


Locating your Emergency Removal Password:

(1) Log in to the Square Enix Account Management System (http://sqex.to/KeD) with your Square Enix ID, password, and One-Time Password.

(2) The Emergency Removal Password can be found on the page after logging in under the section Token Usage Status.


Removing the Software Token from your account:

(1) Go the Emergency Removal page (https://secure.square-enix.com/account/app/svc/coercioncan) and then enter your Square Enix ID, password, and Emergency Removal Password.

(2) Click the URL located within the automatic email that will be sent to the registered email address.

(3) The Software Token will be removed once the URL is accessed.
* The URL will only be valid for 60 minutes.


After removing the Software Token from your account, please uninstall the app from your device. You will then need to reinstall the app and link it to your account (http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/token.html).

body:

title: Current Known Issue for Windows Version Follow-up 2
body:
We previously confirmed an issue wherein the game file FFXI.dll was being removed by some security software. After working with the security software developers, we are pleased to announce that the issue has been resolved.

In cases where the game file was quarantined, we ask that you please update to the latest version of your security software.

We will continue to ensure that other software programs do not cause this issue.

As a preventative measure, users can add the FINAL FANTASY XI files as exceptions in the security software settings. This will prevent the security software from inadvertently removing or quarantining the game files.

* Please consult your security software for instructions on adding exceptions.

title: Login Issue (Apr. 17)
body:
Currently, we are receiving contacts from users in certain environments who have become unable to log in to services connected to their Square Enix Account.

Investigation has revealed that the issue stems from application of the latest Windows Update, which turns off the Use SSL 3.0 setting under Internet Options in Internet Explorer 11.

We ask that users who are experiencing this issue take the following steps to change their Internet Explorer 11 settings.

[Steps]
1. Open Internet Explorer 11
2. Open Internet Options
3. Select the Advanced tab
4. Check the boxes next to the following and click Apply:
- Use TLS 1.0
- Use TLS 1.1
- Use TLS 1.2

[Affected Services]
- FINAL FANTASY XI Forums
- Square Enix Account Management System

title: Important Notice for Square Enix Account Users
body:
In order to strengthen the security of the Square Enix Account system, support for the SSL 3.0 protocol will end on Jul. 22, 2015.

Due to this change resulting in only TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1, and TLS 1.2 protocols being enabled, it is possible that some browser settings may prevent use of the Square Enix Account system.

Please follow the steps below to confirm and configure your browser settings to allow TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1, and TLS 1.2 protocols.


[Affected Services]

-FINAL FANTASY XI Forum
-Square Enix Account Management System
-Square Enix Support Center


[Steps to Confirm/Configure Browser Settings]

-Windows
--Internet Explorer 11
Please update to the latest version.
*If security settings have been configured individually, please disable SSL 3.0 and enable TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1, and TLS 1.2.

--Internet Explorer 10 and earlier
1. Open "Internet Options"
(Tools > Internet Options)
2. Open the "Advanced" tab
3. Uncheck the checkbox for "Use SSL 3.0"
4. Check the checkboxes for the following items:
---Use TLS 1.0
---Use TLS 1.1
---Use TLS 1.2
*May differ by version

--Firefox
Please update to the latest version.
*If config settings have been configured individually, please disable SSL 3.0 and enable TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1, and TLS 1.2.

--Chrome
Please update to the latest version.
*If config settings have been configured individually, please disable SSL 3.0 and enable TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1, and TLS 1.2.

-Mac OS X
--Safari
If you cannot access the above services normally,
please update your software and OS X to the latest version.

--Chrome
If you cannot access the above services normally,
please update to the latest version.

-Smartphone
--iOS Safari
If you cannot access the above services normally,
please update your software and iOS to the latest version.

--All Android browsers
If you cannot access the above services normally,
please update your system software to the latest version.


*Edited on Jul. 22, 2015 9:27 a.m. (PDT)
Added information regarding SSL 3.0 settings in Windows browsers.

We have confirmed and are investigating the below issues.
We ask for your patience as we resolve these issues promptly.

[Currently Known Issues]
- An issue wherein the effects of the following spells are stronger than intended:
    Geohelix II / Hydrohelix II / Anemohelix II

- An issue wherein it is not possible to properly progress through the Wings of the Goddess missions "Edge of Existence" or "Forget Me Not" while undertaking the Rhapsodies of Vana'diel mission "Sacrifice".

- An issue wherein players who have accepted the Wings of the Goddess missions "Edge of Existence" or "Forget Me Not" while undertaking the Rhapsodies of Vana'diel mission "Sacrifice" can only leave The Walk of Echoes by Teleport or Warp.
* If you are unable to leave The Walk of Echoes, please use the in-game Support Desk to request GM assistance.

* The issues involving the "Edge of Existence" and "Forget Me Not" missions were resolved during the maintenance that took place on Aug. 11, 2015 at 5:00 (PDT).

* The issue concerning the magic effects Geohelix II / Hydrohelix II / Anemohelix II was resolved during the maintenance that took place on Aug. 11, 2015 at 23:30 (PDT).

title: Important Notice to All Software Token Users
body:
If you are using a Software Token on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new device or update your device's operating system, you will need to use the Software Token on your current device to obtain an Emergency Removal Password, with which you can remove the current device from your account and re-register your new/updated device to your Square Enix Account.

You can view your Emergency Removal Password on the top page of the Square Enix account management system after logging in.
http://account.square-enix.com

After you have logged in, you can unlink your device from your Square Enix account (e.g. to link a different device) by selecting One-Time Password followed by Software Token and following the on-screen instructions.

You can also visit the following URL to unlink the device if you do not have access to the Software Token but still have the Emergency Removal Password:
http://sqex.to/GPE

If you do not have access to neither your software token nor your Emergency Removal password, please use the following support form to request assistance with unlinking the device from your Square Enix account:
http://sqex.to/o_B

title: Temporary Fixes for Halloween Festival Issues (Oct. 15)
body:
We have determined that players of the PlayStation 2 version of the game may experience blackouts in the game when they approach the areas where Halloween Festival events are being held.

We are currently investigating the issue, however due to the complexity of the issue, as a temporary countermeasure we will be removing graphic-intensive objects and NPCs that have been added for the Halloween Festival.

* Objects/NPCs that may be temporarily removed:

-Southern San d'Oria
"Synergy Furnace"

-Northern San d'Oria
"Synergy Furnace"
"Ensemble Maven"
"Fashionista"
Halloween Festival Costume Contest judge

-Bastok Mines
"Synergy Furnace"
"Ensemble Maven"
"Fashionista"
Halloween Festival Costume Contest judge

-Bastok Markets
"Synergy Furnace"

-Windurst Waters
"Synergy Furnace"
"Ensemble Maven"
"Fashionista"
Halloween Festival Costume Contest judge

*These countermeasures will be enacted based on the conditions seen in each world/area, so some worlds/areas may not be impacted by this.
*We apologize for the inconvenience, but if you find the objects/NPCs missing in your area, please try participating in the event at a different location.

We offer our sincere apologies for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience and understanding.


* Edited on Nov. 3, 2015 at 10:10 (PST)
With the Halloween Festival event having come to a close, the previously removed graphic-intensive objects were restored on Nov. 3, 2015 at 10:00 (PST).

title: Important Notice to All Software Token Users (Nov. 16)
body:
This is a notice concerning the next iOS update, iOS 9.2.

Currently it has been confirmed that when updating to iOS 9.2, an issue may occur where the Software Token may not open.

We ask that you do not update to iOS 9.2 when the update itself is released.

Further information related to any updates on the matter will be detailed in a follow-up news.

If you have updated to iOS 9.2, we have confirmed that the Software Token can be made usable again by first removing the Software Token and then re-downloading and re-registering the Software Token.

As we have noted many other times, to remove the Software Token, you will need your Emergency Removal Password, so we ask that you please have the Emergency Removal Password saved somewhere beforehand.

*You will also need to remove the Software Token when switching smart phone devices as well, so please take the time to check for this situation as well.

*For more information on the Token removal, please go to the url below.
http://sqex.to/LxX

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and we ask for your understanding and patience on this matter.

title: All Software Token Users with the Release of iOS 9.2
body:
The iOS 9.2-compatible version of the SQUARE ENIX Software Token has been released as of Dec. 13, 2015 at 19:00 (PST)

Please be sure to update the Software Token application before you update to iOS 9.2.

[Caution]
- Simply updating the app will not enable iOS 9.2 compatibility.
- After updating the app, you will need to restart the app once in order to enable iOS 9.2 compatibility.
- If you are updating to iOS 9.2, you will need to both update and restart the Software Token app before updating to iOS 9.2.

*In order to check whether or not the software token has been updated or not, after starting the application, select Square Enix Software Token" from the upper-right settings button and see if the version has become 1.2.0.

* Please note that if you update to iOS 9.2 before updating the Software Token app, you will not be able to open the Software Token app. In this situation, you will need to remove the Software Token from your SQUARE ENIX account using the Emergency Removal Password before you re-download and re-register the app.

* As a reminder, if you ever plan to switch phones or delete the app, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password beforehand.

* For more information about removing a Software Token, please visit the URL below:
http://sqex.to/LxX

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and we ask for your understanding and patience regarding this matter.

title: Important Notice to all Software Token Users
body:
If you are using a Software Token, please be sure that you keep your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. If you do not remove your software token from your account beforehand, this password is required to regain access to your account in the following cases:

- You upgrade to a new phone
- You lose your phone
- You delete the application on your phone

You can view your Emergency Removal Password on the top page of the Square Enix account management system (http://account.square-enix.com) after logging in.

If you should find yourself in a situation where you no longer have access to your software token , you can remove it* with the Emergency Removal Password from your account by visiting the following URL and following the on-screen instructions: http://sqex.to/GPE

*Please note that the Emergency Removal Password can only be used once. If you re-register your software token afterwards, you will receive a new Emergency Removal Password.

If you still have your Software Token but wish to remove it from your account, please log in to the Square Enix account management system (http://account.square-enix.com), select One-Time Password followed by Software Token and follow the on-screen instructions.

To re-register a Software Token, please log in to the Square Enix account management system (http://account.square-enix.com), select One-Time Password followed by Software Token and follow the on-screen instructions.

We have confirmed an issue in "Early Spring Battle Content Campaign" which began on Saturday, March 11 at 12:00 a.m. (PST) wherein the rate of seals traded to the NPC "Shemo" at Jeuno Port is 2:1 rather than 3:1.

The issue is being addressed, and we ask for your patience and understanding as we strive to resolve this promptly.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may be causing.

* This issue was resolved with the version update implemented on Mar. 13, 2017 at 2:30 a.m. (PDT)

title: Windows Vista Support Information
body:
We regret to inform you that Final Fantasy XI / PlayOnline will no longer support Windows Vista.

Due to the fact that Microsoft(R) has already completed the support life cycle of this product, we have found that continuing support for this OS is a difficult proposition.

At the time support for this product ceases, the software you are currently using will continue to function and games will still be playable. We will also continue to perform regular updates of existing software. However, after we discontinue support, we will as a general rule no longer be able to provide support for problems arising as a result of the operating system.

Furthermore, customer support for members utilizing this operating system will still be available through the Square Enix Support Center.

Minimum System Requirements Information:
http://sqex.to/nGT

We thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

title: Internet Instability Issue (Aug. 25): Follow-up
body:
We have an update regarding the ongoing internet instability situation.

On Aug. 24, 2017 at around 8:30 p.m. (PDT), upper-tier Internet Service Providers (ISP) experienced technical difficulties which led to a major disruption of internet communications throughout Japan.

This issue caused backbone routers (equipment which provides communication between ISPs, for example, through upper-tier networks) to experience extremely heavy load, and at around Aug. 25, 2017 12:16 a.m. (PDT), resulted in a shutdown in a section of backbone routers that connect with Square Enix servers, thus cutting off communications to our servers.

*Our login and game servers are operating as normal.

Due to this, at around 2:21 a.m. (PDT) we changed what network settings we could on our end to circumvent the downed backbone routers, but we then received information that the same issue was also occurring on other backbone routers serving ISPs used by our players. Thus, it is possible that a solution may take some time.

We are continuing to investigate, but if you are unable to log in or are disconnected from the network, we ask that you please wait a while and try to log in again. We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

title: Important Notice to All Software Token Users (Sep. 19)
body:
This is a notice to all customers who use a Square Enix Software Token (Software Token).

If you are using a Software Token on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or update your device's operating system, or you have deleted your Software Token application, you will need to use your Software Tokens Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token from the old device, after which you must re-register the token to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

* In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.

How to Confirm your Software Token Emergency Removal Password
http://sqex.to/AYg

* The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token registered to your old device.

How to Perform an Emergency Removal of your Software Token
http://sqex.to/mVZ

How to Re-register your Software Token
http://sqex.to/3mQ

* Please be aware that the Software Token registration cannot be completed until you enter your Square Enix ID, date of birth, and registration password into the application.
* The registration password will expire after 60 minutes. If your password expires, you must restart the re-registration process from step 1.
* The Registration Password refers to the password that is sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account in step 7. Please use caution as it is not the same as your Square Enix account password.

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
http://support.na.square-enix.com/

body:

The following issue occurs when upgrading Relic/Mythic/Empyrean/Ergon/Aeonic Weapons.

- Of the five Ultimate Weapon types, if only an Ergon Weapon is possessed:
When speaking to NPC "Oboro", the selection option "Upgrading my weapon even further" will not appear even if augmentation requirements are met.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

title: Important Notice to All Software Token Users (Sep. 18)
body:
This is a notice to all customers who use a Square Enix Software Token (Software Token).

If you are using a Software Token on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or update your device's operating system, or you have deleted your Software Token application, you will need to use your Software Tokens Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token from the old device, after which you must re-register the token to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

* In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.

How to Confirm your Software Token Emergency Removal Password
https://sqex.to/AYg

* The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token registered to your old device.

How to Perform an Emergency Removal of your Software Token
https://sqex.to/mVZ

How to Re-register your Software Token
https://sqex.to/3mQ

* Please be aware that the Software Token registration cannot be completed until you enter your Square Enix ID, date of birth, and registration password into the application.
* The registration password will expire after 60 minutes. If your password expires, you must restart the re-registration process from step 1.
* The Registration Password refers to the password that is sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account in step 7. Please use caution as it is not the same as your Square Enix account password.

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
https://support.na.square-enix.com/

title: Network Technical Difficulties (Oct. 4)
body:
We are currently experiencing network difficulties, which are causing issues with login.

Upon investigation, we have confirmed that our own network environment, as well as our game and account servers are not experiencing any internal errors. The cause of the login interference appears to be a large-scale internet issue occurring across Japan.

We apologize for the inconvenience, but we ask that our players wait a while until the large-scale internet issue recovers.

title: Network Technical Difficulty (Oct.4): Follow-up
body:
Upon further investigation of the ongoing network technical difficulties, we discovered that a DDoS attack is targeting multiple upper-level ISPs, which in turn is affecting our servers. The large-scale attack is affecting various regions of the network connected to our servers and appears to be causing severe internet issues.

We are currently contacting various upper-level ISPs to further confirm the issue and to develop countermeasures.

We ask for your patience and understanding as we continue to address these network technical difficulties.

title: Network Technical Difficulties (Oct.4): Follow-up 2
body:
We would like to provide another update regarding the network technical difficulties caused by the DDoS attacks.

As the ongoing attack was affecting the networks of multiple upper-level ISPs, the upper-level ISPs are now working to address the issue as a top priority. We are also preparing our own countermeasures, but the attacks currently appear to have ceased.

We will continue our defensive measures that had been taken to mitigate the effects of the attacks on players, along with consideration for further precautions, in order to provide the best possible defenses.

title: Updates Regarding Sales of the Square Enix Security Token
body:
Starting July 2, 2019, the Square Enix Security Token will no longer be sold on the Square Enix Account Management System. Instead, the security token will be sold on the Square Enix Store website. Alongside this, the price will be changed to $14.99 (USD). Security tokens add an additional layer of security to your Square Enix Account. Once a token has been registered, you will be required to enter a one-time password generated by the token when logging into any service using a Square Enix Account.

Please note that the Square Enix Software Token will continue to be available free of charge. Users can download the Square Enix Software Token on the App Store or Google Play Store.

More information about the Software Token can be found here:
https://square-enix-games.com/en_US/seaccount/otp/token.html

As a quick and easy way to ensure a safe and secure gaming experience, we highly recommend all users take advantage of the one-time password feature.

title: Important Notice to All Software Token Users (Sep. 18)
body:
This is a notice to all customers who use a Square Enix Software Token (Software Token).

If you are using a Software Token on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or update your device's operating system, or you have deleted your Software Token application, you will need to use your Software Tokens Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token from the old device, after which you must re-register the token to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

* In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.

How to Confirm your Software Token Emergency Removal Password
https://sqex.to/AYg

* The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token registered to your old device.

How to Perform an Emergency Removal of your Software Token
https://sqex.to/mVZ

How to Re-register your Software Token
https://sqex.to/3mQ

* Please be aware that the Software Token registration cannot be completed until you enter your Square Enix ID, date of birth, and registration password into the application.
* The registration password will expire after 60 minutes. If your password expires, you must restart the re-registration process from step 1.
* The Registration Password refers to the password that is sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account in step 7. Please use caution as it is not the same as your Square Enix account password.

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
https://support.na.square-enix.com/

title: Regarding the End of Windows(R) 7 Support
body:
Square Enix support for the Windows(R) 7 of FINAL FANTASY XI will end on January 14, 2020.

Microsoft will no longer provide security updates or support for PCs running Windows(R) 7 after January 14, 2020, so we have found that continuing support for this operating system is a difficult proposition.

You will likely be able to play FINAL FANTASY XI on Windows(R) 7 systems even after the end of support. However, after we discontinue support, we will as a general rule no longer be able to provide support for problems arising as a result of the operating system.

Square Enix may respond to requests for technical support regarding Windows(R) 7 issues after the end of support, but such informal support will be limited, on a case-by-case basis, and is not guaranteed.

<Recommended System Requirements>
We have verified that FINAL FANTASY XI runs on PCs with the following specs and situations listed below, and set it as the recommended system requirements. We have also confirmed that there are no stability issues with Windows(R) 8.1 and Windows(R) 10.
----------
- Operating System
Windows 8.1 / 10*
- CPU
Intel Core i3 2.4GHz (or higher)
- Memory
2GB or more
- Graphics Card
NVIDIA GeForce GT 740 (or higher)
* Driver must be compatible with DirectX 8.1.
- Graphics Card
NVIDIA(R) GeForce(TM) series with 32 MB or ATI(R) RADEON(TM) 9000 series
- Hard Drive Space
15 GB free hard disk space
- Other
Keyboard, mouse, gamepad
Must have DirectX End-User Runtime installed
----------
* Compatibility issues may still arise due to other applications, driver software, custom Windows settings, or hardware configuration.
* Certain Windows 10 updates may cause the game client to work improperly, but we will work to address any critical error if it happens.
* Inquiries regarding the parts listed should be made to their respective manufacturer.
* Administrator privileges are required to install the PlayOnline Viewer and FINAL FANTASY XI.

Settings Used
The following game configuration settings were used during testing:
- Screen Resolution set to 1280x720
- Drawing Precision set to 1024x1024
- Shadows set to Normal
- All settings at High

Stress Tests Performed
The following was performed in order to test load times and overall stability:
- Tested in-game content Domain Invasion and Campaign, as well as macro entry and selecting items from various lists. No significant latency issues arose.
(Domain Invasion was tested with an additional ten players, each with 5 Trust NPCs)

Playability
We have determined that the game meets the standard of being playable based on the following:
- Experienced no gameplay issues related to graphics or connectivity.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

title: Announcing the Termination of Certain PlayOnline Services
body:
The following POL functions and services will end on Thursday, December 26, 2019.

* PlayOnline Mail Address Access
* Sending and receiving of emails using PlayOnline Mail services
* Distribution and support for the PlayOnline Friend List Application
* Community Site links

We regret that we are unable to continue providing these services in light of security concerns and recent usage statistics.

Going forward, we will continue to concentrate our efforts on developing and supporting FINAL FANTASY XI.

Akihiko Matsui
Producer, FINAL FANTASY XI

title: Regarding Duration of the World Transfer Service Discount
body:
Thank you for your continued support of FINAL FANTASY XI.

We have identified a discrepancy between the announced end times and the actual duration for the World Transfer Service discount during the recent Discount Campaign. We apologize for the error and would like to address the issue.

[Issue Details]
We announced the following campaign details on November 1, 2019.

Discount Campaign - World Transfer Service
Campaign Period:
Friday, November 8, at 12:00 a.m. (PST) to Friday, November 29, at the same hour.

However, the World Transfer Service discount actually ended 10 minutes earlier, on November 28 at 11:50 p.m.  A number of earlier World Transfer Service Discount Campaigns also concluded 10 minutes earlier than their announced end times.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

[Resolution]
We will implement measures to ensure that these errors do not occur again for future campaigns.

title: Regarding the End of Windows(R) 7 Support: Follow Up
body:
Thank for for playing FINAL FANTASY XI.

As previously announced, Square Enix support for Windows(R) 7 on FINAL FANTASY XI will end on January 14, 2020.

Microsoft will no longer provide security updates or support for PCs running Windows(R) 7 after January 14, 2020, so we have found that continuing support for this operating system is a difficult proposition.

Square Enix will continue to provide user support to those playing FINAL FANTASY XI on Windows(R) 7, but will be unable to provide any technical support for OS-related issues.

We have also updated the recommended system requirements in line with this change


We have verified that FINAL FANTASY XI runs on PCs with the following specs and situations listed below, and set it as the recommended system requirements. We have also confirmed that there are no stability issues with Windows(R) 8.1 and Windows(R) 10.

????

- Operating System
Windows 8.1 / 10*
- CPU
Intel Core i3 2.4GHz (or higher)
- Memory
2GB or more
- Graphics Card
NVIDIA GeForce GT 740 (or higher)
* Driver must be compatible with DirectX 8.1.
- Sound Card
Sound card whose driver is compatible with DirectX 8.1.
- Hard Drive Space
15 GB free hard disk space
- Internet Connection
A constant internet connection is required.
- Other
Keyboard, mouse, gamepad
Must have DirectX End-User Runtime installed
*Although a gamepad is not strictly required to play, using one together with a keyboard and mouse provides the best experience.
???

* Compatibility issues may still arise due to other applications, driver software, custom Windows settings, or hardware configuration.
* Certain Windows 10 updates may cause the game client to work improperly, but we will work to address any critical errors that may arise.
* Inquiries regarding the parts listed should be made to their respective manufacturer.
* Administrator privileges are required to install the PlayOnline Viewer and FINAL FANTASY XI.

Settings Used
The following game configuration settings were used during testing:
- Screen Resolution set to 1280x720
- Drawing Precision set to 1024x1024
- Shadows set to Normal
- All settings at High

The following was performed in order to test load times and overall stability:
- Tested in-game content Domain Invasion and Campaign, as well as macro entry and selecting items from various lists. No significant latency issues arose.
(Domain Invasion was tested with an additional ten players, each with 5 Trust NPCs)

Playability
We have determined that the game meets the standard of being playable based on the following:
- Experienced no gameplay issues related to graphics or connectivity.

We have updated the following entries on the official site in line with the above changes.
- Platforms > Windows(R)
https://sqex.to/nGT
- Play Guide > Game Manual > Main Menu > Config
https://sqex.to/uq5rc
- Download > Windows(R) Uninstall
https://sqex.to/Y0U1Y

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

title: COVID-19 Update: Temporary Support Closure (Mar. 20)
body:
We have been monitoring the situation surrounding COVID-19 carefully, increasing our safety procedures and protocols, and reducing our operations to help limit the spread of the virus while continuing to assist our customers.

Due to recent orders issued by the County of Los Angeles and State of California, customer support will be temporarily closing.

Due to these precautionary measures, we have decided to temporarily close phone and chat support until further notice. Email support will be available but please understand that there may be a delay in response. While we understand that this will be an inconvenience to our customers, please rest assured that our teams have plans in place to resume customer support and service as soon as possible.

In the meantime, we recommend that you please keep checking PlayOnline for all the latest news and announcements.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience but we thank you for your continued support and understanding.

title: Important Notice to All Software Token Users (Oct. 20)
body:
This is a notice to all customers who use a Square Enix Software Token (Software Token).

If you are using a Software Token on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or update your device's operating system, or you have deleted your Software Token application, you will need to use your Software Tokens Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token from the old device, after which you must re-register the token to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

* In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.

How to Confirm your Software Token Emergency Removal Password
https://sqex.to/AYg

* The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token registered to your old device.

How to Perform an Emergency Removal of your Software Token
https://sqex.to/mVZ

How to Re-register your Software Token
https://sqex.to/3mQ

* Please be aware that the Software Token registration cannot be completed until you enter your Square Enix ID, date of birth, and registration password into the application.
* The registration password will expire after 60 minutes. If your password expires, you must restart the re-registration process from step 1.
* The Registration Password refers to the password that is sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account in step 7. Please use caution as it is not the same as your Square Enix account password.

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
https://sqex.to/s5G9O

title: Notice about Software Tokens/Authentication Apps (Sep. 21)
body:
This is a notice to all customers who use a Software Token or Software Authenticator.

If you are using a Software Token or Software Authenticator (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.) on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or delete the app, you will need to use an Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator from the old device, after which you must re-register the app to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

*In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.

How to confirm your Emergency Removal Password

(1) Log in to the Square Enix Account Management System.

Square Enix Account Management System:
https://sqex.to/fHa

(2) After you have logged into the Square Enix Account Management System, your Emergency Removal Password will be displayed under Token Usage Status below the Square Enix Account Information section.

*The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the above steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator registered to your old device.

How to perform an emergency removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator

(1) Go to the Software Token/Software Authenticator Emergency Removal page and enter your Square Enix ID and password and your Emergency Removal Password.

Software Token Emergency Removal page:
https://sqex.to/GPE

(2) An email containing the Software Token/Software Authenticator removal URL will be sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account.

(3) Click on the URL to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator
* Note that the URL will expire after 60 minutes. Please be sure to click on it and complete the removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator before it expires.

How to Re-register your Software Token/Software Authenticator

Please visit the links below for step-by-step instructions on re-registering your app.
[Software Token] https://sqex.to/TPSj1
[Software Authenticator] https://sqex.to/2HJDL

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified. Please review the FAQ below for further details.

How do I remove the Square Enix Security Token from my account?
https://sqex.to/mVZ

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center

title: Important Notice for Square Enix Account Users
body:
In order to strengthen the security of the Square Enix Account system, support for the TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 protocols will end on Jul. 26th, 2022 (Tuesday).

Due to this change resulting in only the TLS 1.2 protocol being enabled, it is possible that some browser settings may prevent use of the Square Enix Account system.

Please follow the steps below to confirm and configure your browser settings to allow the TLS 1.2 protocol.


[Steps to Confirm/Configure Browser Settings]

-Windows
--Microsoft Edge
   Please update to the latest version.
   *If security settings have been configured individually, please disable TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1, and enable TLS 1.2.

--Firefox
   Please update to the latest version.
   *If config settings have been configured individually, please TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1, and enable TLS 1.2.

--Google Chrome
   Please update to the latest version.
   *If security settings have been configured individually, please disable TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1, and enable TLS 1.2.

-macOS
--Safari
   If you cannot access the above services normally, please update your software and macOS to the latest version.

--Google Chrome
   If you cannot access the above services normally, please update to the latest version.

-Smartphone
--iOS Safari
   If you cannot access the above services normally, please update your software and iOS to the latest version.

--All Android browsers
   If you cannot access the above services normally, please update your system software to the latest version.

-Game Console
If you are unable to access the above services, please update your game console software to the latest version.
Nintendo systems: Update the console
Sony Computer Entertainment systems: System Software Update

title: Notice about Software Tokens/Authentication Apps (Sep. 12)
body:
This is a notice to all customers who use a Software Token or Software Authenticator.

If you are using a Software Token or Software Authenticator (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.) on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or delete the app, you will need to use an Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator from the old device, after which you must re-register the app to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

*In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.

How to confirm your Emergency Removal Password

(1) Log in to the Square Enix Account Management System.

Square Enix Account Management System:
https://sqex.to/fHa

(2) After you have logged into the Square Enix Account Management System, your Emergency Removal Password will be displayed under Token Usage Status below the Square Enix Account Information section.

*The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the above steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator registered to your old device.

How to perform an emergency removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator

(1) Go to the Software Token/Software Authenticator Emergency Removal page and enter your Square Enix ID and password and your Emergency Removal Password.

Software Token Emergency Removal page:
https://sqex.to/GPE

(2) An email containing the Software Token/Software Authenticator removal URL will be sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account.

(3) Click on the URL to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator
* Note that the URL will expire after 60 minutes. Please be sure to click on it and complete the removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator before it expires.

How to Re-register your Software Token/Software Authenticator

Please visit the links below for step-by-step instructions on re-registering your app.
[Software Token] https://sqex.to/TPSj1
[Software Authenticator] https://sqex.to/2HJDL

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified. Please review the FAQ below for further details.

How do I remove the Square Enix Security Token from my account?
https://sqex.to/mVZ

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
https://sqex.to/s5G9O

title: Important Notice About Purchases and Subscriptions
body:
In late February, we are planning to change the payment processor used for purchases made on the FINAL FANTASY XIV: Mog Station, FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store, and Square Enix Account Management sites. This change should not have an impact on most purchases, but we wanted to inform and clearly communicate to customers of any potential changes.  

The change should not impact customers who are currently enrolled in a recurring subscription plan. However, future updates to an existing recurring subscription, such as starting a new recurring subscription or making updates to the payment method on existing recurring subscriptions, will be processed through the new payment processor. Switching an existing recurring subscription plan to the new payment processor will require the re-registration of their payment method. Although the current payment processor will continue to be available for a period following the change, we recommend updating an active recurring subscription after the change occurs as this will help prevent any account access disruptions in the event that the current payment processor is no longer available.

Furthermore, some of the existing payment methods will no longer be available following the change. While we hope to reintroduce some of the discontinued payment methods over time, we recommend considering alternate payment methods in the meantime. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.  Please see below for affected payment methods.

Unavailable Payment Methods: JCB, Carte Bleue, SEPA (Sofort) Available Payment Methods: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Amazon Pay, Paysafecard

Additionally, customers may notice other minor differences following the change: the manner in which credit card charges show up on billing statements may be slightly different, or banks may request fraud verification on purchases that used to be approved without such additional steps. While the changes should not impact purchases, we do recommend our customers to review any charges made after the change for due diligence purposes, and to ensure any charges are for purchases made from Square Enix.

It is possible that with the change in payment processor, transactions that previously had no issues are now declined. In such cases, please contact the Square Enix Support Center (https://sqex.to/s5G9O) so we may look into and resolve the matter with you.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the changes described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center (https://sqex.to/s5G9O).

title: Notice about Software Tokens/Authentication Apps (Sep. 18)
body:
This is a notice to all customers who use a Software Token or Software Authenticator.

If you are using a Software Token or Software Authenticator (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.) on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or delete the app, you will need to use an Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator from the old device, after which you must re-register the app to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

*In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.

How to confirm your Emergency Removal Password

(1) Log in to the Square Enix Account Management System.

Square Enix Account Management System:
https://sqex.to/fHa

(2) After you have logged into the Square Enix Account Management System, your Emergency Removal Password will be displayed under Token Usage Status below the Square Enix Account Information section.

*The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the above steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator registered to your old device.

How to perform an emergency removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator

(1) Go to the Software Token/Software Authenticator Emergency Removal page and enter your Square Enix ID and password and your Emergency Removal Password.

Software Token Emergency Removal page:
https://sqex.to/GPE

(2) An email containing the Software Token/Software Authenticator removal URL will be sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account.

(3) Click on the URL to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator
* Note that the URL will expire after 60 minutes. Please be sure to click on it and complete the removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator before it expires.

How to Re-register your Software Token/Software Authenticator

Please visit the links below for step-by-step instructions on re-registering your app.
[Software Token] https://sqex.to/TPSj1
[Software Authenticator] https://sqex.to/2HJDL

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified. Please review the FAQ below for further details.

How do I remove the Square Enix Security Token from my account?
https://sqex.to/mVZ

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
https://sqex.to/s5G9O

title: Important Update About Purchases and Subscriptions (Apr. 5)
body:
The change to the payment processor used for purchases on the FINAL FANTASY XIV: Mog Station, FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store and Square Enix Account Management sites is scheduled to be implemented on April 23, 2024.This should not have an impact on most purchases, but we want to share some information to help make the transition as smooth as possible. 

After April 23, 2024, we will be confirming the address for the account for payment security purposes. You can confirm and update your registered address by logging into the Square Enix Account Management System and accessing the Account Information section from the "Account" menu.

This change should not have an impact on customers who have a recurring subscription.However, customer payments will begin using the new payment processor as soon as any change is made to an existing subscription plan, such as changing the payment method, or setting up a new recurring subscription.We recommend making changes to your account after April 24, 2024 to prevent any disruption.

Please note that some payment methods that are currently offered will not be available after the transition.While we are planning to add more payment methods in the future, for now you will need to choose from the available payment methods:

Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Amazon Pay, and Paysafecard

Unfortunately, we will not be able to accept JCB, Carte Bleue, SEPA (ELV).We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

We recommend due diligence when reviewing charges after the change to ensure they are from Square Enix for purchases you made. You may notice that credit card charges  appear differently on your bank statement, or your bank may request additional fraud verification for new purchases.  

In cases where a transaction is declined, you encounter error messages, or you have any other difficulties with payments, please contact the Square Enix Support Center (https://sqex.to/s5G9O) so we can assist you.

body:

You can confirm and update your registered address by logging into the Square Enix Account Management System (https://secure.square-enix.com/) and accessing the "Account Information" section from the "Account" menu.

title: Notice about Software Tokens/Authentication Apps (Sep. 17)
body:
This is a notice to all customers who use a Software Token or Software Authenticator.

If you are using a Software Token or Software Authenticator (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.) on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or delete the app, you will need to use an Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator from the old device, after which you must re-register the app to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

*In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.
*New registrations for Software Tokens have closed as of November 21, 2023, so please use Software Authenticator Apps or Square Enix Security Tokens (Key Ring Type) after performing the Emergency Removal.

How to confirm your Emergency Removal Password

(1) Log in to the Square Enix Account Management System.

Square Enix Account Management System:
https://sqex.to/fHa

(2) After you have logged into the Square Enix Account Management System, your Emergency Removal Password will be displayed under Token Usage Status below the Square Enix Account Information section.

*The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the above steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator registered to your old device.

How to perform an emergency removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator

(1) Go to the Software Token/Software Authenticator Emergency Removal page and enter your Square Enix ID and password and your Emergency Removal Password.

Software Token Emergency Removal page:
https://sqex.to/GPE

(2) An email containing the Software Token/Software Authenticator removal URL will be sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account.

(3) Click on the URL to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator
* Note that the URL will expire after 60 minutes. Please be sure to click on it and complete the removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator before it expires.

How to Re-register your Software Token/Software Authenticator

Please visit the links below for step-by-step instructions on re-registering your app and purchasing a Square Enix Security Token.
*New registrations for Software Tokens have closed as of November 21, 2023, so they may no longer be used after an Emergency Removal.
Please use Software Authenticator Apps or Square Enix Security Tokens (Key Ring Type).

[Software Authenticator] https://sqex.to/2HJDL
[Purchase Square Enix Security Tokens (Key Ring Type)] https://sqex.to/451zR

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token or Software Authenticator yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified. Please review the FAQ below for further details.

How do I remove the Square Enix Security Token from my account?
https://sqex.to/mVZ

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
https://sqex.to/s5G9O

title: Current Known Issues (Oct. 16)
body:
We have confirmed the following issues. We are currently investigating, and the fixes are expected to occur in the next Vana'Bout - Round 4.

[Confirmed Issues]

- In Vana'Bout - Round 3's list of objectives, the name of the following objective is incorrect.
Incorrect: Heroines' Tower (VBD)
Correct: Heroines' Holdfast (VBD)

- In Vana'Bout - Round 3's personal rewards Gold Tier list, the following key item name is incorrect.
Incorrect: Old toolbox
Correct: Ra'Kaznar Plate Fragment
*This is only a display issue. The item "Ra'Kaznar Plate Fragment" is correctly obtained.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may be causing.

title: Current Known Issue (Oct. 17)
body:
We have confirmed the following issue. We are currently investigating, and fixes are expected to occur in the next Vana'Bout - Round 4.

[Confirmed Issue]

- In Vana'Bout - Round 3's Vana'Bout Daily, the required element to complete certain objectives is listed incorrectly.

Objective: Deal 500+ Lightning Damage (VBD)
>Earth damage is actually required.

Objective: Deal 500+ Water Damage (VBD)
>Lightning damage is actually required.

Objective: Deaal 500+ Fire Damage (VBD)
>Water damage is actually required.

*Additionally, regarding Fire damage objectives, there are unfortunately two versions that both exist: One in which the element required to complete the objective is actually Water damage but it incorrectly states 'Fire damage', and one in which both the actual element required and stated in the objective is Fire damage.

To distinguish between the two, the one for which "the element required is actually Water damage, but incorrectly states 'Fire damage'" contains the spelling error "Deaal" in the objective, so please use that to differentiate.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may be causing.

title: Regarding the End of Windows® 10 Support
body:
FINAL FANTASY XI support for Windows® 10 will end on October 14, 2025.

Microsoft will no longer provide security updates or support for PCs running Windows® 10 after October 14, 2025 so we have found that continuing support for this operating system is a difficult proposition.

You will likely be able to play FINAL FANTASY XI on Windows® 10 systems even after the end of support. However, after we discontinue support, we will as a general rule no longer be able to provide support for problems arising as a result of the operating system.

Square Enix may respond to requests for technical support regarding Windows® 10 issues after the end of support, but such informal support will be limited, on a case-by-case basis, and is not guaranteed.

In addition, to accompany this change, the OS/CPU requirements for the Windows® version will be updated on October 14, 2025. Please see below for the updated requirements.
https://sqex.to/nGT

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

title: Notice about Software Tokens/Authentication Apps (Sep. 16)
body:
This is a notice to all customers who use a Software Token or Software Authenticator.

If you are using a Software Token or Software Authenticator (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.) on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or delete the app, you will need to use an Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator from the old device, after which you must re-register the app to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

*In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.
*New registrations for Software Tokens have closed as of November 21, 2023, so please use Software Authenticator Apps or Square Enix Security Tokens (Key Ring Type) after performing the Emergency Removal.

How to confirm your Emergency Removal Password

(1) Log in to the Square Enix Account Management System.

Square Enix Account Management System:
https://sqex.to/fHa

(2) After you have logged into the Square Enix Account Management System, your Emergency Removal Password will be displayed under Token Usage Status below the Square Enix Account Information section.

*The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the above steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator registered to your old device.

How to perform an emergency removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator

(1) Go to the Software Token/Software Authenticator Emergency Removal page and enter your Square Enix ID and password and your Emergency Removal Password.

Software Token Emergency Removal page:
https://sqex.to/GPE

(2) An email containing the Software Token/Software Authenticator removal URL will be sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account.

(3) Click on the URL to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator
* Note that the URL will expire after 60 minutes. Please be sure to click on it and complete the removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator before it expires.

How to Re-register your Software Token/Software Authenticator

Please visit the links below for step-by-step instructions on re-registering your app and purchasing a Square Enix Security Token.
*New registrations for Software Tokens have closed as of November 21, 2023, so they may no longer be used after an Emergency Removal.
Please use Software Authenticator Apps or Square Enix Security Tokens (Key Ring Type).

[Software Authenticator] https://sqex.to/2HJDL
[Purchase Square Enix Security Tokens (Key Ring Type)] https://sqex.to/451zR

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token or Software Authenticator yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified. Please review the FAQ below for further details.

How do I remove the Square Enix Security Token from my account?
https://sqex.to/mVZ

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
https://sqex.to/s5G9O

title: Regarding Certain Daily Objectives for Vana'Bout  Round 7
body:
In the currently ongoing Vana'Bout  Round 7 objectives that were achievable under normal circumstances became unattainable due to specific gameplay conditions.

Since this objective may be set up to three times during the period, we will proceed with the following actions assuming all targets have been achieved.

*Individual Compensation
The required amount of Plaudits for achieving each award will be reduced by 60 points.
-Gold: 1,200 -> 1,140 Plaudits
-Silver: 700 -> 640 Plaudits
-Bronze: 200 -> 140 Plaudits
Please note that you may hold or acquire any Plaudits already obtained by achieving the relevant goal, or any Plaudits that may be obtained in the future.

*Total Compensation
Since we are already nearing 150% at this point, only the amount of Plaudits obtained by characters who participated in Vana'Bout will be reflected.


The necessary maintenance will be performed as soon as preparations are complete. The exact date and time will be announced via in-game system messages and other channels.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused.

title: Current Known Issue (Jan. 27)
body:
We have confirmed an issue in Limbus where defeated Notorious Monsters may reappear in some cases.

Our investigation revealed that this occurs because the server-side data recording the defeat status of Notorious Monsters is unexpectedly being cleared. We have implemented an interim measure to prevent this from happening again. However, there is currently no way to tell if a Notorious Monster is still undefeated or has reappeared due to the data being cleared. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

If the Notorious Monsters remain undefeated until the end of the current kill tally period, they will not be counted as defeated for this period. This will affect treasure coffer changes in the next period. Therefore, for this period, we will treat all Notorious Monsters as defeated across all worlds.

To achieve this, Game Masters will visit each World in sequence and defeat each Notorious Monster individually. We apologize for the inconvenience, but if you intend to fight Notorious Monsters for the purpose of obtaining unique data, please challenge them by the date and time below.

Game Master schedule:
From Jan. 29, 2026 17:00 to Jan. 30, 2026 06:59 (PST)

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

title: SQUARE ENIX ACCOUNT Removal of Security Question and Answer
body:
As part of our ongoing efforts to improve customer experience, please be aware that the Security Question and Answer fields in the registered information of Square Enix Accounts will be removed on February 24, 2026.

This means that this information will no longer be requested when creating an account, and if you have previously entered these details, they will no longer be visible on your account.

This information was formerly used as part of the verification process when making changes to your account but will not be required in future.

Rest assured that this change is part of our ongoing efforts to improve your experience while maintaining account security.

To further enhance the security of your account, we strongly recommend enabling two-factor authentication (2FA) for an additional layer of protection.

For more information on how to set up 2FA, please refer to the article below.
https://support.na.square-enix.com/faqarticle.php?kid=78777&ret=main&id=496&la=1

title: Current Known Issue (Jul. 15)
body:
We have confirmed the following issue. We are currently investigating and ask for your patience as we work to resolve this issue.

[Confirmed Issue]
When using the Character Race Change Service from the Ancestry Moogle NPC at Port Bastok, there may be issues such as the background music not switching correctly, or your character's original appearance not being shown even when "Display old" is selected in the character display settings.

*Due to this issue, we have temporarily removed this NPC from the game. We will make an announcement at a later time regarding when the NPC will be available again.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may be causing.

*Update: Aug. 12, 2026 3:20 (PDT)
This issue was addressed by the maintenance on Aug. 11, 2026 22:00 to Aug. 12, 2026 0:30 (PDT).
The NPC mentioned above was temporarily removed as a stopgap measure, but has been restored now that the issue is fixed.

title: All Worlds Maintenance (Aug. 11)
body:
At the following time, we will be performing server maintenance in order to accompany a version update for FINAL FANTASY XI. During this period, FINAL FANTASY XI will be unavailable.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your patience.

*This maintenance will be accompanied by a client program version update. After maintenance is complete, the update will automatically begin after you press the Play button. After that, please follow the instructions on the screen.

*World transfer services will become unavailable 30 minutes prior to the maintenance period.

*After the maintenance ends, a spike in access is expected.
If you encounter congestion errors such as POL-1160 and POL-0010 during the confirmation screen or while downloading, we apologize for the inconvenience, and we ask that you try again after waiting for some time.

To ensure a smooth version update, we ask for your understanding and cooperation.

*Update details will be announced on Aug. 11, 2026 (PDT).
